name: 香菇
fact: 菌盖上的白色龟裂纹是低温干燥时表皮跟不上菌肉膨胀撑开的，花菇的价格就来自这层裂纹。
quote: 我身上的花纹是冻出来的，不是画上去的。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色，表面常有白色龟裂状鳞片
菌褶白色，菌柄偏生且带纤维鳞片
长在阔叶树段木上，栽培品常见于木架

idKeysEn: Cap brown, surface often cracked with white scale-like patches
Gills white; stem off-center, with fibrous scales
Grows on hardwood logs; cultivated stock common on wooden racks
factEn: The white cracks on the cap form when cool, dry air can't keep pace with the flesh swelling underneath, splitting the skin apart. That crackling pattern is exactly what makes premium 'flower mushroom' shiitake pricier.
quoteEn: My cracks are grown in the cold, not painted on.

name: 平菇
fact: 平菇的菌丝会分泌毒素麻痹线虫再消化它们——它是一种会捕食动物的蘑菇。
quote: 素食？我可从没这么说过。

idKeys.text: 贝壳形或扇形菌盖，灰白至灰褐色，侧生短柄
菌褶白色，向下延生到柄
层叠丛生于阔叶树的枯干和倒木上

idKeysEn: Cap shell- or fan-shaped, gray-white to grayish brown, with a short lateral stem
Gills white, running down onto the stem
Grows in overlapping clusters on dead hardwood trunks and fallen logs
factEn: Oyster mushroom mycelium secretes a toxin that paralyzes tiny roundworms, then digests them — this is a mushroom that actually preys on animals.
quoteEn: Vegetarian? I never said that.

name: 金针菇
habitat: 栽培瓶；野生型见于阔叶树枯干
fact: 超市里雪白细长的金针菇是在黑暗高二氧化碳环境里逼出来的，野生型菌盖褐色、菌柄短而粗。
quote: 我在黑屋子里长大，所以这么白。

idKeys.text: 野生个体菌盖黄褐色黏滑，与超市白色细长的栽培品完全不同
菌柄下部深褐色，密生短绒毛
冬季丛生于阔叶树枯木，雪天也能见到

idKeysEn: Wild caps yellow-brown and sticky, unlike the slender white cultivated form sold in stores
Lower stem dark brown, densely covered in short velvety hairs
Clusters on dead hardwood in winter, even visible in snow
habitatEn: Cultivation bottles; wild form on dead hardwood trunks
factEn: The pale, slender enoki sold in supermarkets is forced to grow in the dark under high CO2; the wild form has a brown cap and a short, stubby stem.
quoteEn: I grew up in a dark room, that's why I'm this pale.

name: 杏鲍菇
habitat: 野生型与刺芹等伞形科植物根部共生
fact: 它是少数与草本植物而非树木结伴的侧耳，野生型只长在刺芹枯死的根上。
quote: 别人靠树，我靠一株草。

idKeys.text: 菌柄粗壮白色，比菌盖还显眼
菌盖褐色，边缘内卷，菌褶向下延生
野生个体长在伞形科植物的根部

idKeysEn: Stem thick and white, more conspicuous than the cap
Cap brown with an inrolled margin; gills run down the stem
Wild specimens grow at the roots of umbellifer plants
habitatEn: Wild form lives on the roots of eryngo and other umbellifers
factEn: It's one of the few oyster mushrooms that partners with an herb instead of a tree — in the wild it grows only on the dead roots of eryngo (sea holly).
quoteEn: The others lean on trees. I lean on a weed.

name: 黑木耳
fact: 中国栽培的黑木耳 2014 年才被确认是独立种，此前一直被误当成欧洲的犹太耳。
quote: 泡发之后我能胖十倍，别小看我。

idKeys.text: 耳状胶质，深褐至黑褐色，湿时半透明有弹性
干后收缩变硬变黑，遇水又能恢复
丛生于阔叶树枯木和段木上

idKeysEn: Ear-shaped and gelatinous, dark brown to blackish brown; translucent and rubbery when wet
Shrinks, hardens, and blackens when dry, reviving when wetted
Clusters on dead hardwood and cut logs
factEn: The wood ear cultivated in China wasn't confirmed as its own species until 2014 — before that it was mistaken for Europe's jelly ear.
quoteEn: Soak me and I'll swell to ten times my size. Don't underestimate me.

name: 银耳
fact: 银耳自己长不出耳片，必须先有「香灰菌」把木头分解掉，它才能靠着这位邻居出耳。
quote: 我需要一个室友才能出门。

idKeys.text: 洁白半透明，花瓣状裂片层层叠叠
胶质柔软，干后变硬变黄
长在阔叶树枯木上

idKeysEn: Pure white and translucent, with petal-like lobes layered on layered
Soft and gelatinous, turning hard and yellow when dry
Grows on dead hardwood
factEn: Snow fungus can't fruit on its own — a partner fungus, the 'incense-ash fungus,' has to break the wood down first before it can grow alongside that neighbor.
quoteEn: I need a roommate before I can even step outside.

name: 猴头菇
fact: 它没有菌褶也没有菌管，孢子长在垂下来的一根根肉刺表面，刺可以长到 5 厘米。
quote: 我的头发就是我的器官。

idKeys.text: 整体白色团块，密生下垂的针状齿刺
没有菌盖和菌柄之分，像一团白毛
长在活的阔叶树伤口或枯木上

idKeysEn: A white mass covered in dense, hanging spine-like teeth
No distinct cap or stem, resembling a ball of white fur
Grows on wounds of living hardwoods or on dead wood
habitatEn: Wounds on oak, walnut and other hardwoods
factEn: It has no gills and no pores — spores form on the surface of dangling fleshy spines, which can grow up to 5 cm long.
quoteEn: My hair is my organ.

name: 双孢蘑菇
fact: 白蘑菇、褐菇、大褐菇（波特菇）是同一个物种的不同品系与成熟度，不是三种蘑菇。
quote: 我有三个艺名。

idKeys.text: 白色或褐色圆润菌盖，菌褶粉红转深褐
菌柄有薄菌环，基部无菌托
几乎只见于栽培，野外极少

idKeysEn: Cap rounded, white or brown; gills pink, aging to dark brown
Stem with a thin ring; base lacks a volva
Almost only seen in cultivation, very rare in the wild
factEn: White button, cremini, and portobello are the same species at different strains and stages of maturity — not three separate mushrooms.
quoteEn: I go by three stage names.

name: 蟹味菇
fact: 菌盖上的大理石花纹是它的名字来源，白玉菇只是同一种的白色品系。
quote: 生吃发苦，加热才甜——请务必炒熟。

idKeys.text: 菌盖灰褐色，表面有大理石般的斑纹
丛生成一大簇，菌柄白色
野生个体长在阔叶树枯木上

idKeysEn: Cap grayish brown, marbled with mottled patterning
Grows in a large cluster; stem white
Wild specimens grow on dead hardwood
factEn: The marbled pattern on its cap gives the beech mushroom its name; the white 'bunashimeji' sold alongside it is just a pale strain of the same species.
quoteEn: Raw, I turn bitter. Cooked, I turn sweet — do cook me through.

name: 滑子菇
fact: 表面那层黏液是多糖，能锁住水分让它在干燥季节不失水，也是日式味噌汤里滑口感的来源。
quote: 滑不留手，是我的防晒霜。

idKeys.text: 菌盖橙褐色，表面覆盖一层透明黏液
密集丛生于阔叶树枯木上
菌柄有黏质菌环痕迹

idKeysEn: Cap orange-brown, coated in a layer of clear slime
Densely clustered on dead hardwood
Stem shows a gelatinous ring zone
factEn: The slick coating on its surface is a polysaccharide that locks in moisture during dry spells — it's also what gives miso soup its silky texture when nameko is stirred in.
quoteEn: Slippery is my sunscreen.

name: 毛头鬼伞
fact: 它成熟时菌褶会自我消化成黑色墨汁滴落，这样孢子能被带得更远——采下来几小时就会化掉。
quote: 我保鲜期只有一个下午。

idKeys.text: 菌盖白色圆柱形，覆盖大片翘起的鳞片
成熟后从边缘开始自溶成黑色墨汁
常见于草地、路边和新翻的土地

idKeysEn: Cap white and cylindrical, covered in large upturned scales
Deliquesces into black ink starting from the margin as it matures
Common on lawns, roadsides, and freshly disturbed ground
factEn: As it matures, its gills digest themselves into dripping black ink, helping spores travel farther — pick one and it will dissolve within hours.
quoteEn: My shelf life is one afternoon, tops.

name: 大球盖菇
fact: 市场上叫它「赤松茸」，但它和松茸不是一个科，只是菌盖颜色接近而已。
quote: 我叫赤松茸，跟松茸没有半点亲戚关系。

idKeys.text: 菌盖酒红至褐色，大型，菌褶灰紫转黑
菌柄粗壮白色，有厚而带齿的菌环
长在木屑和覆盖物上，常见于栽培和花坛

idKeysEn: Cap wine-red to brown, large; gills grayish purple, aging to black
Stem thick and white, with a thick, toothed ring
Grows on wood chips and mulch, common in cultivation and flower beds
habitatEn: Ground mulched with straw or wood chips
factEn: Markets sell it as 'red matsutake,' but it isn't even in the same family as true matsutake — the cap color is just a coincidence.
quoteEn: They call me 'red matsutake.' Matsutake and I aren't even cousins.

name: 榆黄蘑
fact: 鲜黄色在干燥后几乎完全褪掉，干品和普通平菇很难分辨。
quote: 我的黄色带不走，晒干就没了。

idKeys.text: 亮黄色扇形菌盖，层叠丛生
菌褶白色，向下延生到短柄
长在榆树等阔叶树的枯木上

idKeysEn: Cap bright yellow, fan-shaped, growing in overlapping clusters
Gills white, running down onto a short stem
Grows on dead elm and other hardwoods
factEn: Its vivid yellow fades almost completely once dried, making the dried product nearly impossible to tell apart from plain oyster mushroom.
quoteEn: My yellow doesn't travel. Dry me out and it's gone.

name: 灰树花
fact: 日文名「舞茸」的说法是采菌人找到它会高兴得跳舞——野生的一丛可以重达十几公斤。
quote: 找到我的人据说会跳舞。

idKeys.text: 许多灰褐色扇形裂片叠成一大丛，像一朵花
下表面白色有细孔，没有菌褶
长在栎树等阔叶树的树基

idKeysEn: Many grayish brown fan-shaped lobes stack into a large cluster, flower-like
Underside white with fine pores, no gills
Grows at the base of oak and other hardwoods
factEn: Its Japanese name, 'maitake,' or 'dancing mushroom,' supposedly comes from foragers dancing with joy on finding one — a wild cluster can weigh over ten kilograms.
quoteEn: Legend says whoever finds me starts dancing.

name: 灵芝
fact: 中国传统所用的赤芝直到 2012 年才与欧洲的 Ganoderma lucidum 正式分开，定名 G. lingzhi。
quote: 传统上用作药材——不是食物。

idKeys.text: 肾形或扇形菌盖，红褐色带漆样光泽
有同心环纹，边缘常带黄白色生长边
菌柄侧生，同样有光泽，长在阔叶树树基或根部

idKeysEn: Cap kidney- or fan-shaped, reddish brown with a lacquered sheen
Marked with concentric rings; margin often has a pale yellow-white growth band
Stem lateral, equally glossy; grows at the base or roots of hardwoods
habitatEn: Oak, chestnut and other hardwood stumps
factEn: The red reishi used in Chinese tradition wasn't formally split from Europe's Ganoderma lucidum until 2012, when it was named Ganoderma lingzhi.
quoteEn: Traditionally used as medicine — not as food.

name: 云芝
fact: 要和长得极像的毛韧革菌（假云芝）区分，得翻过来看背面：云芝有细密菌孔，假云芝背面是光滑的。
quote: 想认出我？请把我翻过来。

idKeys.text: 薄而韧的扇形，多色同心环带像火鸡尾羽
上表面有细绒毛，下表面白色有细孔
层叠密生于枯木上，一年四季可见

idKeysEn: Thin, tough, and fan-shaped, with multicolored concentric bands like a turkey's tail
Upper surface finely velvety; underside white with fine pores
Grows in dense overlapping tiers on dead wood, visible year-round
factEn: To tell it apart from its lookalike, the hairy curtain crust, flip it over: turkey tail has a fine, porous underside, while the impostor's back is smooth.
quoteEn: Want to know it's really me? Turn me over.

name: 紫丁香蘑
fact: 资料记载须彻底加热后食用，生食会引起胃肠不适；紫色会随成熟逐渐褪成褐色。
quote: 我年轻时很紫，老了就不紫了。

idKeys.text: 整体紫丁香色，菌盖成熟后转褐
菌褶紫色，菌柄同色而基部略膨大
秋末长在落叶层和堆肥上，有果香

idKeysEn: Overall lilac colored, cap fading to brown with age
Gills lilac; stem the same color, slightly swollen at the base
Grows in leaf litter and compost in late autumn, with a fruity smell
factEn: Records say it must be cooked thoroughly, as eating it raw causes stomach upset; its purple hue fades to brown as it matures.
quoteEn: I was purple when I was young. Not so much anymore.

name: 蜜环菌
habitat: 活树基部与树桩，成大丛
fact: 它的黑色菌索在夜里会发出微弱绿光，这就是林间「狐火」传说的来源之一。
quote: 我的绳子会在夜里发光。

idKeys.text: 蜜黄至褐色菌盖，中央有细小鳞片
菌柄有明显的白色膜质菌环
大丛生于树基和树根，常成片

idKeysEn: Cap honey-yellow to brown, with fine scales at the center
Stem with a prominent white membranous ring
Grows in large clusters at tree bases and roots, often in extensive patches
habitatEn: Base of living trees and stumps, in large clumps
factEn: Its black root-like cords, called rhizomorphs, glow faintly green at night — one source behind old legends of 'foxfire' in the woods.
quoteEn: My cords glow at night.

name: 冬菇
habitat: 阔叶树枯干，常在雪中出菇
fact: 它是野生型的金针菇：菌盖橙褐带黏液，菌柄基部有一层黑褐色绒毛，能在结冰后化冻继续生长。
quote: 下雪我才出门。

idKeys.text: 橙黄色黏滑菌盖，小型
菌柄深褐色，密生天鹅绒般的短绒毛
冬季丛生于阔叶树枯木，没有菌环

idKeysEn: Cap small, orange-yellow, and sticky
Stem dark brown, densely covered in velvety short hairs
Clusters on dead hardwood in winter, no ring
habitatEn: Dead hardwood trunks, often fruiting in snow
factEn: This is the wild form of enoki: a sticky, orange-brown cap and a stem with a dark velvety base, able to thaw out after freezing and keep growing.
quoteEn: I only come out when it snows.

name: 硬柄小皮伞
fact: 草地上的「仙环」是菌丝从一点向四周等速扩张形成的，环每年向外长十几厘米，最老的环有几百岁。
quote: 我在草地上画圈，一年画大一点。

idKeys.text: 菌盖淡褐色钟形，中央略凸起
菌褶稀疏，菌柄细而坚韧，掰不断只能扭
草坪上排成弧形或圆环

idKeysEn: Cap pale brown, bell-shaped, with a slight central bump
Gills sparse; stem thin and tough, bends rather than breaks
Forms arcs or rings on lawns
habitatEn: Lawns and pastures, often in rings
factEn: The 'fairy rings' on lawns form as mycelium spreads outward from a single point at a steady rate, growing the ring by roughly ten centimeters a year — the oldest rings are centuries old.
quoteEn: I draw circles on the lawn, a little bigger every year.

name: 四孢蘑菇
fact: 幼时菌褶粉红、成熟转深褐是蘑菇属的共同特征；若菌褶始终纯白，就要警惕是不是鹅膏属。
quote: 看我的菌褶颜色，别只看菌盖。

idKeys.text: 白色菌盖，菌褶粉红成熟后变深褐
菌柄有薄菌环，基部不膨大也无菌托
长在草地和牧场，气味清香

idKeysEn: Cap white; gills pink, darkening to deep brown with age
Stem with a thin ring; base not swollen and lacks a volva
Grows in meadows and pastures, with a pleasant smell
factEn: Pink gills that darken to deep brown with age are a hallmark of the Agaricus genus; if the gills stay pure white, be wary — that could signal an Amanita instead.
quoteEn: Check my gill color. Don't just look at the cap.

name: 松乳菇
fact: 掰开会流出胡萝卜色的乳汁，暴露在空气里会慢慢变绿，被压伤的地方也会染上铜绿色。
quote: 我流橙色的血，然后伤口会变绿。

idKeys.text: 橙色菌盖带同心环纹，中央下凹
受伤流出橙红色乳汁，之后变绿
长在松树下，秋季成片出现

idKeysEn: Cap orange with concentric zones, center depressed
Bleeds orange-red latex when cut, later staining green
Grows under pine, appearing in patches in autumn
factEn: Break it open and carrot-orange milk oozes out, slowly turning green in the air; bruised spots stain a verdigris green too.
quoteEn: I bleed orange. Then the wound turns green.

name: 青头菌
fact: 菌盖表皮会龟裂成一块块青绿色斑，像干涸的河床——但绿色的剧毒鹅膏也存在，颜色不能当依据。
quote: 绿色不等于安全，这话我说给自己听。

idKeys.text: 菌盖灰绿色，表皮龟裂成斑块状
菌褶白色，菌柄白色粗壮而脆
长在阔叶林地面，没有菌环和菌托

idKeysEn: Cap grayish green, surface cracking into patches
Gills white; stem white, stout, and brittle
Grows on the floor of hardwood forests, no ring or volva
factEn: The cap skin cracks into patches of green, like a dried-up riverbed — but deadly green Amanitas exist too, so color alone is never proof.
quoteEn: Green doesn't mean safe. I remind myself of that too.

name: 蓝黄红菇
fact: 红菇属大多菌褶一碰就碎，它却柔韧得能像油纸一样弯折而不断，这是最好认的特征。
quote: 别的红菇一掰就碎，我不会。

idKeys.text: 菌盖颜色多变，紫、绿、蓝灰常混在一起
菌褶白色柔韧，用手指摩擦不碎，区别于其它红菇
菌柄白色，长在阔叶林

idKeysEn: Cap color variable, often a mix of purple, green, and blue-gray
Gills white and pliable, not crumbling when rubbed, unlike other Russula
Stem white; grows in hardwood forests
factEn: Most Russula gills crumble at a touch, but this one is pliable enough to bend like oiled paper without snapping — its best field mark.
quoteEn: Other russulas snap when you bend them. I don't.

name: 稀褶红菇
fact: 伤口先变红、再转黑，整朵最后变成焦炭色；剧毒的亚稀褶红菇只变红不变黑，这是关键差别。
quote: 我先红后黑。只红不黑的那位，很危险。

idKeys.text: 菌盖灰白至褐色，受伤先变红再慢慢变黑
菌褶厚而稀疏，是红菇里最稀的
老菌整体变黑，可留存到第二年

idKeysEn: Cap grayish white to brown, bruising red then slowly blackening
Gills thick and widely spaced, the most sparse of any Russula
Old fruitbodies blacken entirely and can persist into the following year
factEn: A bruise turns red first, then black, until the whole mushroom looks charred; the deadly rank russula only turns red and never black — a critical difference.
quoteEn: I go red, then black. The one that only goes red — that one's dangerous.

name: 美味牛肝菌
fact: 菌柄上那层白色网纹是它的身份证；苦粉孢牛肝菌的网纹粗黑，尝一口极苦，能毁掉一整锅汤。
quote: 看我柄上的白网。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色，边缘略浅，像烤过的面包
菌柄粗壮，上部有白色细网纹
菌孔白色转黄绿，切开不变色

idKeysEn: Cap brown, margin slightly paler, like a baked loaf
Stem stout, with fine white netting on the upper part
Pores white, aging to yellow-green; flesh does not change color when cut
habitatEn: Ground in pine and oak woods
factEn: The fine white netting on its stem is porcini's ID card; the bitter bolete's netting is coarse and dark, and one bite of it is bitter enough to ruin an entire pot of soup.
quoteEn: Look at the white net on my stem.

name: 兰茂牛肝菌
fact: 「见手青」不是一个物种，而是云南人对一类伤后迅速变蓝的牛肝菌的统称，变蓝来自菌肉里的色素被酶氧化。
quote: 别碰我，我会脸青的。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色，菌孔黄色，受伤迅速变蓝
菌柄黄色带红褐斑，按压也变蓝
云南常见的牛肝菌，长在松林

idKeysEn: Cap brown, pores yellow, bruising blue quickly
Stem yellow with reddish brown spots, also bluing under pressure
A bolete common in Yunnan, growing in pine forests
factEn: 'Jian Shou Qing' isn't one species — it's a Yunnan folk name for a group of boletes whose flesh turns blue almost instantly when bruised, as enzymes oxidize pigments inside.
quoteEn: Don't touch me, I'll turn blue in the face.

name: 玫黄黄肉牛肝菌
fact: 云南叫它「白葱」，同属见手青家族，菌肉伤后同样变蓝，资料记载须彻底炒熟。
quote: 白葱、红葱，我们是一家人。

idKeys.text: 菌盖灰白至淡黄褐，菌孔淡黄
菌柄淡黄色，基部略带红
长在云南的松栎林

idKeysEn: Cap grayish white to pale yellowish brown, pores pale yellow
Stem pale yellow, faintly reddish at the base
Grows in pine-oak forests of Yunnan
factEn: Known in Yunnan as 'white onion,' it belongs to the same blue-staining bolete family, with flesh that bruises blue too; records say it must be cooked thoroughly.
quoteEn: White onion, red onion — we're family.

name: 褐环乳牛肝菌
fact: 菌盖那层厚黏液在雨后能滑得抓不住，资料记载食用前须去掉表皮，否则容易引起腹泻。
quote: 雨天的我，你抓不住。

idKeys.text: 褐色菌盖覆盖一层滑腻黏液
菌柄上有明显的膜质菌环，这在乳牛肝菌里少见
菌孔黄色，长在松树下

idKeysEn: Cap brown, coated in a slippery layer of slime
Stem with a prominent membranous ring, unusual among Suillus
Pores yellow; grows under pine
factEn: The thick slime on its cap gets so slippery after rain you can barely hold it; records say the skin must be peeled off before eating, or it can cause diarrhea.
quoteEn: Catch me on a rainy day — you can't.

name: 厚环乳牛肝菌
habitat: 落叶松林，只与落叶松共生
fact: 它只跟落叶松结伴，找到一棵落叶松就有希望找到它，反之在别的松树下白找。
quote: 没有落叶松，就没有我。

idKeys.text: 菌盖亮黄至橙黄色，湿时黏滑发亮
菌柄有淡黄色胶质菌环，菌孔黄色，受伤略变褐
只长在落叶松树下

idKeysEn: Cap bright yellow to orange-yellow, sticky and glossy when wet
Stem with a pale yellow gelatinous ring; pores yellow, browning slightly when bruised
Grows only under larch
factEn: It only partners with larch trees — find a larch and you stand a chance of finding it; look under any other pine and you're wasting your time.
quoteEn: No larch, no me.

name: 鸡油菌
fact: 它下面不是真正的菌褶，而是一道道向菌柄延伸的钝棱脊，用手摸是圆钝的；杰克灯的是薄而锐利的真菌褶。
quote: 摸一摸我的棱，圆的才是我。

idKeys.text: 整体蛋黄色，漏斗形，边缘波状
下方是钝而分叉的棱脉，不是薄片状的真菌褶
单生或散生于林地土中，不长在木头上

idKeysEn: Overall egg-yolk yellow, funnel-shaped, with a wavy margin
Underside has blunt, forked ridges, not true blade-like gills
Grows singly or scattered in forest soil, never on wood
habitatEn: Ground in oak and pine woods
factEn: What looks like gills underneath are really blunt, forking ridges running down toward the stem, rounded to the touch; the jack-o'-lantern's are thin, sharp, true gills.
quoteEn: Feel my ridges. Round means it's really me.

name: 灰喇叭菌
fact: 被称为「穷人的松露」，一身炭黑贴着落叶，采菌人常常踩过去才发现脚边一大片。
quote: 你多半已经从我身上走过去了。

idKeys.text: 黑灰色喇叭形，薄而中空
外侧光滑或有细皱，没有菌褶
丛生于阔叶林落叶层，容易看漏

idKeysEn: Blackish gray, trumpet-shaped, thin and hollow
Outer surface smooth or finely wrinkled, no gills
Clusters in hardwood leaf litter, easy to overlook
habitatEn: Leaf litter in oak and beech woods
factEn: Nicknamed the 'poor man's truffle,' its charcoal-black body blends into leaf litter so well that foragers often walk right past a whole patch before spotting it underfoot.
quoteEn: You've probably already walked right past me.

name: 羊肚菌
fact: 菌盖上的蜂窝状凹坑是子囊层，孢子从坑壁弹射出去；资料记载必须彻底煮熟，生食有中毒记录。
quote: 我的坑洼不是伤，是我的产房。

idKeys.text: 帽部像蜂窝，布满不规则凹坑
帽与柄连成一体，整体中空
春季出现，长在林缘和火烧迹地

idKeysEn: Cap honeycomb-like, covered in irregular pits
Cap fused to the stem, entirely hollow inside
Appears in spring, growing at woodland edges and burn sites
habitatEn: Woodland edges, burnt ground and river flats
factEn: The honeycomb pits on its cap are the spore-bearing layer, firing spores from the pit walls; records say it must be cooked thoroughly, as raw morels have caused poisoning.
quoteEn: My pits aren't scars. They're my nursery.

name: 黑脉羊肚菌
fact: 这是中国大田栽培羊肚菌的主力种，「黑脉」指的是纵向棱脊成熟后变黑。
quote: 我是少数被人类驯服的野味。

idKeys.text: 帽部深褐至黑色，纵向棱脊像梯子
帽与柄连成一体，整体中空
春季长在木屑、花坛和城市绿地

idKeysEn: Cap dark brown to black, with vertical ridges like a ladder
Cap fused to the stem, entirely hollow inside
Grows in spring on wood chips, flower beds, and urban green spaces
factEn: This is the leading species grown in China's field-cultivated morel industry; 'black-veined' refers to the vertical ridges darkening as it matures.
quoteEn: I'm one of the rare wild foods humans actually managed to tame.

name: 长裙竹荪
fact: 它清晨出土，几小时内撑开雪白网裙，下午就开始倒伏自溶——一朵竹荪的完整一生不到一天。
quote: 我的裙子只穿一个上午。

idKeys.text: 菌柄白色海绵状，顶端是墨绿色带臭味的孢体帽
帽下垂着白色网状菌裙，展开后像一条裙子
长在竹林和阔叶林，从一颗白色的蛋里长出

idKeysEn: Stem white and spongy, topped with a foul-smelling olive-green spore cap
A white net-like skirt hangs from beneath the cap, unfurling like a dress
Grows in bamboo and hardwood forests, emerging from a white "egg"
factEn: It emerges at dawn, unfurls its snow-white lace skirt within hours, then collapses and dissolves by afternoon — a bamboo fungus lives its whole life in under a day.
quoteEn: I only wear this skirt for one morning.

name: 松茸
habitat: 赤松、高山松活根，外生菌根
fact: 它必须与活着的松树根共生，至今无法人工栽培；一朵松茸从菌丝侵染到出菇要五六年。
quote: 没有活着的松树，就没有我。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色，覆盖纤维状鳞片
菌柄粗壮，上有厚实的膜质菌环
有独特的松香辛辣味，长在松树下

idKeysEn: Cap brown, covered in fibrous scales
Stem stout, with a thick membranous ring
Has a distinctive spicy, piney smell; grows under pine
habitatEn: Ectomycorrhizal on living roots of red pine and mountain pines
factEn: It must live in symbiosis with living pine roots and still can't be cultivated; from the moment its mycelium colonizes a root to the moment a mushroom appears takes five or six years.
quoteEn: No living pine, no me.

name: 姬松茸
fact: 名字里有「松茸」，其实是蘑菇属的栽培种，跟松茸完全不同科；它有明显的杏仁味。
quote: 名字蹭了热度，我道歉。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色带鳞片，菌褶粉红转深褐
有明显的杏仁香味
长在堆肥和富含腐殖质的土上

idKeysEn: Cap brown with scales; gills pink, darkening to deep brown
Has a pronounced almond smell
Grows in compost and humus-rich soil
factEn: Despite the 'matsutake' in some of its names, it's actually a cultivated Agaricus species in a completely different family from true matsutake, with a distinct almond scent.
quoteEn: My name rode on someone else's fame. Sorry about that.

name: 黑皮鸡枞
habitat: 栽培；野生型见于腐木埋土
fact: 市场上叫「黑皮鸡枞」，其实是长根菇，跟真正的鸡枞不同科，好处是能人工栽培。
quote: 我能被种出来，那位不能。

idKeys.text: 菌盖深褐至黑色，湿时黏滑
菌柄细长白色，向下延伸成假根
长在阔叶林地面，栽培品常见

idKeysEn: Cap dark brown to black, sticky when wet
Stem slender and white, tapering downward into a rooting base
Grows on the floor of hardwood forests; common in cultivation
habitatEn: Cultivated; wild form on buried rotting wood
factEn: Sold as 'black-skin termite mushroom,' it's actually a long-rooted Oudemansiella in a different family from true termite mushrooms — the upside is it can be cultivated.
quoteEn: I can be farmed. That other one can't.

name: 干巴菌
fact: 它长成一丛扇状裂片，缝里常夹着松针和沙土，清洗一斤干巴菌要花上一个钟头。
quote: 洗我很费事，这是我贵的一部分原因。

idKeys.text: 灰白至灰褐色，扇形裂片叠成一丛
质地坚韧，没有菌盖菌柄之分
长在云南的松林地面，常夹着松针

idKeysEn: Grayish white to grayish brown, fan-shaped lobes stacked into a cluster
Texture tough, with no distinction between cap and stem
Grows on the floor of Yunnan pine forests, often tangled with pine needles
factEn: It grows as a cluster of fan-shaped lobes, with pine needles and grit wedged into every crevice — cleaning half a kilo of it can take a full hour.
quoteEn: Cleaning me is a chore. That's part of why I cost so much.

name: 翘鳞肉齿菌
fact: 云南叫「黑虎掌」，菌盖上翘起的大鳞片像虎皮，背面不是菌褶而是密密的肉刺。
quote: 翻过来看，我背着一片针。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色，覆盖粗大的深色翘起鳞片
菌盖下方是灰白色的齿刺，不是菌褶
长在南方的松林和栎林地面

idKeysEn: Cap brown, covered in coarse, dark, upturned scales
Underside bears grayish white spines, not gills
Grows on the floor of pine and oak forests in southern regions
habitatEn: Ground in spruce and pine woods
factEn: Called 'black tiger paw' in Yunnan, its upturned cap scales resemble tiger stripes, and the underside isn't gills but a dense mat of fleshy spines.
quoteEn: Turn me over — I'm carrying a field of needles.

name: 卷缘齿菌
fact: 欧洲采菌人喜欢它，因为没有任何有毒的蘑菇长着这种奶油色的软刺——不过这不代表可以凭一个特征下结论。
quote: 我的刺一碰就掉。

idKeys.text: 菌盖奶油黄色，形状不规则
菌盖下方是细密的白色针状齿刺
菌柄白色，长在林地

idKeysEn: Cap creamy yellow, irregularly shaped
Underside bears fine white needle-like spines
Stem white; grows in woodland
habitatEn: Ground in broadleaf and conifer woods
factEn: European foragers love it because no poisonous mushroom shares its soft, cream-colored spines — though that's still no reason to identify by a single trait alone.
quoteEn: My spines fall off at the slightest touch.

name: 大马勃
fact: 一个大马勃能产生几万亿个孢子，如果全部成活，两代之后体积就会超过地球。
quote: 我一口气能吐几万亿个孩子。

idKeys.text: 白色大球，可以长到足球大
表面光滑，没有菌柄，直接贴地
长在草地和牧场，切开幼时内部纯白

idKeysEn: A large white ball, growing as big as a soccer ball
Surface smooth, stemless, sitting directly on the ground
Grows in meadows and pastures; flesh pure white inside when young
factEn: A single giant puffball can produce several trillion spores — if every one of them survived, two generations later their combined mass would outweigh the Earth.
quoteEn: I can release trillions of children in one breath.

name: 网纹马勃
fact: 成熟后顶端开一个小孔，雨滴打上去像捏皮球一样把孢子喷出来，这是靠雨水传播的巧妙设计。
quote: 雨滴敲我一下，我就喷一次。

idKeys.text: 白色梨形，表面布满细小锥刺
刺脱落后留下网状纹
成熟后顶端开口，一按就喷出褐色孢子

idKeysEn: White and pear-shaped, covered in tiny conical spines
Spines leave a net-like pattern once shed
An apical pore opens at maturity, puffing brown spores when pressed
factEn: Once mature, a small pore opens at the top; raindrops striking it squeeze out puffs of spores like squeezing a rubber ball — a clever trick for rain-powered dispersal.
quoteEn: One raindrop taps me, and out puffs a cloud.

name: 尖顶地星
fact: 外层包被成熟时裂成星芒向外翻卷，把中间的孢子囊举离地面，好让风带走孢子。
quote: 我把自己撑起来，只为了让风够得着。

idKeys.text: 外皮裂成星状瓣，中央一个球
球的基部有一圈领状结构
长在落叶层，成熟后顶端开口喷孢子

idKeysEn: Outer layer splits into star-shaped rays around a central ball
The ball has a collar-like ring at its base
Grows in leaf litter; an apical pore opens to puff spores at maturity
factEn: As it matures, the outer layer splits into star-shaped rays that curl back, lifting the central spore sac off the ground so wind can carry the spores away.
quoteEn: I prop myself up just so the wind can reach me.

name: 硬皮地星
fact: 星芒会随空气湿度开合：潮湿时张开，干燥时又抱成一团，所以被叫作「气压计地星」。
quote: 我就是一台不用电的湿度计。

idKeys.text: 外皮裂成星状，星瓣表面有龟裂纹
潮湿时星瓣张开，干燥时合拢，像晴雨表
长在沙质土和路边

idKeysEn: Outer layer splits into a star, the rays cracked on the surface
Rays open when damp and close when dry, acting like a barometer
Grows in sandy soil and along roadsides
factEn: Its star-shaped rays open and close with humidity — spreading wide in damp air, curling shut when dry — which is how it earned the name 'barometer earthstar.'
quoteEn: I'm a humidity gauge that runs on nothing.

name: 隆纹黑蛋巢菌
fact: 杯子里的「蛋」是孢子包，雨滴落进杯中会把它弹出一米多远，杯壁的斜度就是为这一下算好的。
quote: 我等一场雨，把孩子弹出去。

idKeys.text: 小杯状，杯内装着几个扁圆的小包，像鸟巢里的蛋
杯外壁褐色有毛，内壁有纵纹
长在腐木和木屑上，雨滴溅出小包传播

idKeysEn: Small and cup-shaped, holding several flattened round packets like eggs in a nest
Outer cup wall brown and hairy; inner wall lined
Grows on rotten wood and wood chips; raindrops splash the packets out to disperse them
factEn: The 'eggs' in its little cup are spore packets; a raindrop landing inside can launch one over a meter away, with the cup's slanted walls angled exactly for the shot.
quoteEn: I wait for a rainstorm, then launch my children into the world.

name: 墨汁鬼伞
fact: 它含鬼伞素，本身加热后影响不大，但与酒同食会阻断酒精代谢，引起心悸潮红，症状可在几天后再次饮酒时重现。
quote: 跟我一起喝酒的人，都后悔了。

idKeys.text: 菌盖灰褐色，钟形到卵形，表面有细密纵纹
成熟后菌盖边缘自溶成黑色墨汁状液体
丛生于树桩或埋木附近的地面，常成簇出现

lookalikeNotes.shaggyink: 毛头鬼伞菌盖白色圆柱形带大片鳞片；墨汁鬼伞灰褐色光滑
lookalikeNotes.micaceus: 晶粒小鬼伞更小、橙黄色，菌盖有闪亮颗粒

idKeysEn: Cap grayish brown, bell- to egg-shaped, finely lined on the surface
Cap margin deliquesces into black ink-like liquid at maturity
Clusters on the ground near stumps or buried wood, often in tight groups

lookalikeNotesEn.shaggyink: Shaggy ink cap has a white, cylindrical cap with large shaggy scales; common inkcap is smooth and grey-brown.
lookalikeNotesEn.micaceus: Glistening inkcap is smaller and tawny-orange, with a cap dusted in glittering granules.

factEn: It contains coprine, which causes little trouble on its own once cooked, but combined with alcohol it blocks alcohol metabolism, triggering flushing and a racing heart — symptoms that can return even days later if you drink again.
quoteEn: Everyone who's had a drink with me has regretted it.

name: 晶粒小鬼伞
fact: 幼菌盖上覆着一层云母般的闪亮颗粒，是菌幕的残余，雨水一冲就没了。
quote: 我身上的闪粉，下场雨就没了。

idKeys.text: 菌盖橙黄色钟形，表面有闪亮的云母状颗粒
密集丛生于树桩和埋木附近
成熟后菌盖边缘自溶变黑

idKeysEn: Cap orange-yellow, bell-shaped, with glistening mica-like granules
Densely clustered near stumps and buried wood
Cap margin deliquesces black at maturity
habitatEn: Base of stumps, often in large clumps
factEn: A young cap is dusted with mica-like glittering flecks, leftover remnants of its veil — one good rain washes them away.
quoteEn: My glitter washes off with the next rain.

name: 毒鹅膏
habitat: 栎树等阔叶树下，外生菌根
fact: 全球蘑菇中毒致死案例中它占比最高。鹅膏毒肽耐高温，烹煮无法破坏；中毒后有 1–2 天症状缓解的「假愈期」，极易延误就医。
quote: 我很好看。也有人说我很好吃——只是没人活着回来夸我。

idKeys.text: 菌柄基部有一圈白色杯状菌托，常埋在落叶下
菌盖黄绿至橄榄色，湿时略带光泽，边缘无条纹
菌褶始终白色，菌柄上部有白色膜质菌环

lookalikeNotes.greenrussula: 青头菌没有菌环和菌托，菌柄脆，一掰就断
lookalikeNotes.caesar: 凯撒鹅膏菌盖橙红、菌褶和菌柄黄色；死帽菇菌盖橄榄绿、菌褶白色

idKeysEn: Stem base has a white cup-shaped volva, often buried under leaf litter
Cap yellow-green to olive, faintly glossy when wet; margin not striate
Gills remain white; upper stem has a white membranous ring
habitatEn: Ectomycorrhizal under oak and other hardwoods

lookalikeNotesEn.greenrussula: Green-cracking russula has no ring or volva, and its brittle stem snaps cleanly.
lookalikeNotesEn.caesar: Caesar's mushroom has an orange-red cap with yellow gills and stem; death cap has an olive-green cap and white gills.

factEn: It accounts for more mushroom poisoning deaths worldwide than any other species. Its amatoxins survive cooking unchanged, and victims often go through a deceptive 1-2 day period of feeling better before symptoms return — a delay that can cost precious time before help is sought.
quoteEn: I'm handsome. Some say I'm delicious too — no one's lived to confirm it.

name: 鳞柄白鹅膏
fact: 通体纯白，有菌环也有菌托。它与可食的野蘑菇最大区别是孢子印白色、菌褶始终不变褐。
quote: 纯白，是我唯一的伪装。

idKeys.text: 通体纯白，菌柄基部有大型白色囊状菌托
菌盖光滑无鳞片，成熟后略呈丝绸质感
菌褶白色不变粉，这一点区别于可食的蘑菇属

lookalikeNotes.button: 双孢蘑菇菌褶粉红转褐色且无菌托；毁灭天使菌褶始终白色，基部有菌托
lookalikeNotes.fieldmushroom: 野蘑菇菌褶粉红转深褐，基部无菌托；毁灭天使菌褶纯白且有菌托
lookalikeNotes.horsemushroom: 大肥菇菌褶粉褐、擦伤变黄、有茴香味；毁灭天使菌褶纯白无气味

idKeysEn: Entirely white, with a large white sac-like volva at the stem base
Cap smooth, without scales, faintly silky at maturity
Gills stay white and never turn pink, unlike similar Agaricus mushrooms
habitatEn: Ground in oak and birch woods

lookalikeNotesEn.button: Button mushroom's gills turn pink then brown and it has no volva; destroying angel's gills stay white and its base sits in a volva.
lookalikeNotesEn.fieldmushroom: Field mushroom's gills turn pink then dark brown, with no volva; destroying angel's gills are pure white and it has a volva.
lookalikeNotesEn.horsemushroom: Horse mushroom has pinkish-brown gills, bruises yellow and smells of aniseed; destroying angel has pure white gills and no odour.

factEn: Pure white all over, with both a ring and a volva. Its biggest difference from edible field mushrooms is a white spore print and gills that never turn brown.
quoteEn: Pure white is my only disguise.

name: 灰花纹鹅膏
fact: 中国因误食蘑菇死亡的案例中，它排在首位。菌盖灰褐色、灰扑扑毫不起眼——「颜色鲜艳才有毒」这句话在它面前完全失效。
quote: 我一点也不鲜艳。这就是我最危险的地方。

idKeys.text: 菌盖深灰至灰褐色，有放射状深色纤维纹
菌柄白色带灰色鳞片，基部有白色囊状菌托
菌褶白色，菌柄上部有白色菌环

lookalikeNotes.grisette: 灰鹅膏没有菌环，菌盖边缘有明显条纹；灰花纹鹅膏有菌环且边缘无条纹

idKeysEn: Cap dark gray to grayish brown, with radiating dark fibrils
Stem white with grayish scales; base has a white sac-like volva
Gills white; upper stem has a white ring

lookalikeNotesEn.grisette: Grisette has no ring and a clearly striate cap margin; East Asian death cap has a ring and a smooth margin.

factEn: It ranks first among mushroom-poisoning deaths in China. Its cap is a dull, unassuming grayish-brown — proof that 'only bright colors are dangerous' is simply false.
quoteEn: I'm not flashy at all. That's exactly what makes me dangerous.

name: 毒蝇伞
fact: 菌盖上的白点是幼时包裹整朵菇的菌幕碎片，被大雨冲掉后就成了一顶光秃秃的红伞。
quote: 童话里的红伞白点是我。童话没讲后半段。

idKeys.text: 红色菌盖上散布白色疣状鳞片，雨后可能被冲掉
菌柄白色，基部球状膨大并有数圈环带状菌托残迹
菌柄上部有下垂的白色菌环

lookalikeNotes.caesar: 凯撒鹅膏菌盖光滑无白点，菌褶和菌柄黄色
lookalikeNotes.eggamanita: 橙盖鹅膏菌盖橙红光滑无白疣，菌褶黄色
lookalikeNotes.blusher: 赭盖鹅膏菌盖褐红、受伤变红，疣点易脱落且不成整齐排列
lookalikeNotes.amanitajack: 美洲橙盖鹅膏菌盖光滑无白点，边缘有条纹，菌褶黄色

idKeysEn: Cap red, scattered with white wart-like scales that may wash off after rain
Stem white, with a bulbous base ringed by several bands of volva remnants
Upper stem has a drooping white ring
habitatEn: Ectomycorrhizal, on the ground in birch and pine woods

lookalikeNotesEn.caesar: Caesar's mushroom has a smooth cap without white spots, and yellow gills and stem.
lookalikeNotesEn.eggamanita: Half-dyed slender caesar has a smooth orange-red cap with no white warts, and yellow gills.
lookalikeNotesEn.blusher: The blusher has a brownish-red cap that reddens when damaged; its warts rub off easily and are not neatly arranged.
lookalikeNotesEn.amanitajack: American Caesar has a smooth cap with no white spots, a striate margin and yellow gills.

factEn: The white spots on its cap are leftover fragments of the veil that once wrapped the whole young mushroom — a heavy rain can wash them all away, leaving a bare red cap.
quoteEn: I'm the red cap with white spots from every fairy tale. The stories skip the ending.

name: 豹斑鹅膏
fact: 与毒蝇伞同属神经精神型毒菌，毒素含量往往更高；菌盖褐色带白点，菌托边缘有一圈明显的环带。
quote: 红的那位出名，我更烈。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色，密布纯白色小疣点，排列较整齐
菌柄基部球状膨大，上方有一至数圈环带状菌托边缘
菌环白色，菌褶白色，菌盖边缘有细条纹

lookalikeNotes.blusher: 赭盖鹅膏受伤变红且基部无环带状菌托边缘；豹斑鹅膏不变色

idKeysEn: Cap brown, densely covered in neat rows of pure white warts
Stem base bulbous, with one to several ring-like volva edges above it
Ring white, gills white; cap margin finely striate
habitatEn: Ground in broadleaf and conifer woods

lookalikeNotesEn.blusher: The blusher reddens when damaged and lacks the rim-like volva band at the base; panther cap does not change colour.

factEn: A neurotoxic mushroom in the same category as fly agaric, and often more potent; its cap is brown with white spots, and the volva has a distinct collar-like rim.
quoteEn: The red one gets the fame. I'm the stronger one.

name: 柠檬黄鹅膏
fact: 掰开有明显的生土豆气味，这是与毒鹅膏区分的线索之一——但气味从来不足以作为判断依据。
quote: 我闻起来像生土豆。

idKeys.text: 菌盖淡柠檬黄至近白色，常带白色片状菌幕残片
菌柄基部有明显的球形膨大，边缘有一圈菌托痕
闻起来有生土豆的气味

idKeysEn: Cap pale lemon-yellow to nearly white, often patched with white veil remnants
Stem base distinctly bulbous, rimmed with a volva scar
Smells of raw potato
habitatEn: Ground in oak and pine woods
factEn: Break it open and it smells distinctly of raw potato, one clue for telling it apart from the death cap — though smell alone should never be the deciding factor.
quoteEn: I smell like a raw potato.

name: 赭盖鹅膏
fact: 被虫咬或碰伤的地方会慢慢泛出酒红色，这是它名字的由来；生食含溶血毒素，资料记载须彻底加热。
quote: 你碰我，我会脸红。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐红色，带灰白色疣状鳞片
受伤或被虫蛀处慢慢变红，是名字的由来
菌柄有菌环，基部膨大但菌托不明显

idKeysEn: Cap reddish brown, with grayish white wart-like scales
Bruised or insect-damaged spots slowly turn red, the source of its name
Stem has a ring; base swollen but volva indistinct
habitatEn: Ground in broadleaf and conifer woods
factEn: Spots nibbled by insects or bruised by a touch slowly flush wine-red, which is how it got its name; raw specimens contain a blood-cell-destroying toxin, and records say it must be cooked thoroughly.
quoteEn: Touch me and I'll blush.

name: 橙盖鹅膏
fact: 罗马皇帝喜欢它，因此得名。它与剧毒的同属亲戚只隔着几个特征，历史上误采致死的记录并不少。
quote: 皇帝爱吃我。皇帝也有懂菌的仆人。

idKeys.text: 菌盖橙红色光滑，边缘有条纹
菌褶和菌柄都是黄色
基部有大而松软的白色菌托

idKeysEn: Cap orange-red and smooth, margin striate
Gills and stem both yellow
Base has a large, loose white volva
factEn: Named for the Roman emperors who favored it, it's separated from its deadly Amanita cousins by only a handful of features, and history records no shortage of fatal misidentifications.
quoteEn: Emperors loved me. Emperors also kept servants who knew their mushrooms.

name: 红黄鹅膏
fact: 云南叫「鸡蛋菌」，幼时被白色菌托整个包住像颗蛋。它与剧毒的黄盖鹅膏同属，采食风险很高。
quote: 破壳的时候，我像一颗蛋。

idKeys.text: 菌盖橙红至红色，边缘有明显条纹
菌褶和菌柄黄色，菌柄有环带状花纹
基部有白色囊状菌托，幼时像一颗蛋

idKeysEn: Cap orange-red to red, margin clearly striate
Gills and stem yellow; stem banded with ring-like markings
Base has a white sac-like volva, egg-like when young
habitatEn: Oak woodland in Yunnan and elsewhere
factEn: Called 'egg mushroom' in Yunnan, a young specimen is fully wrapped in a white volva and looks just like an egg. It shares its genus with the deadly East Asian yellow death cap, making foraging risky.
quoteEn: Breaking out of my shell, I look just like an egg.

name: 黄盖鹅膏
fact: 含鹅膏毒肽，是东亚地区重要的致死种；黄褐色菌盖容易被当成可食的橙盖鹅膏或鸡蛋菌。
quote: 我和「鸡蛋菌」只差一点点颜色。

idKeys.text: 菌盖黄色至黄褐色，中央颜色较深
菌柄白色，基部有白色囊状菌托
菌环白色膜质，菌褶白色，多见于松林与阔叶林

lookalikeNotes.eggamanita: 橙盖鹅膏菌盖橙红有边缘条纹，菌褶黄色；黄盖鹅膏菌褶白色，边缘无条纹
lookalikeNotes.caesar: 凯撒鹅膏菌褶和菌柄黄色；黄盖鹅膏菌褶白色

idKeysEn: Cap yellow to yellowish brown, darker at the center
Stem white, base with a white sac-like volva
Ring white and membranous, gills white; found in pine and hardwood forests
habitatEn: Mixed conifer-broadleaf forests of East Asia

lookalikeNotesEn.eggamanita: Half-dyed slender caesar has an orange-red cap with a striate margin and yellow gills; East Asian yellow death cap has white gills, no striations.
lookalikeNotesEn.caesar: Caesar's mushroom has yellow gills and stem; East Asian yellow death cap has white gills.

factEn: It contains amatoxins and is a major cause of death in East Asia; its yellow-brown cap is easily mistaken for the edible Caesar's mushroom or egg mushroom.
quoteEn: The egg mushroom and I differ by little more than a shade of color.

name: 灰鹅膏
fact: 它是少见的没有菌环却有菌托的鹅膏，菌盖边缘有明显的放射状棱纹；剧毒的灰花纹鹅膏与它外形接近。
quote: 我没有菌环，但我有菌托。

idKeys.text: 菌盖灰色，边缘有明显的放射状条纹
没有菌环，这在鹅膏里少见
基部有白色囊状菌托，菌柄细长

idKeysEn: Cap gray, margin distinctly radially striate
Lacks a ring, unusual for an Amanita
Base has a white sac-like volva; stem slender
habitatEn: Ground in broadleaf and conifer woods
factEn: It's an unusual Amanita with a volva but no ring, and its cap edge shows distinct radiating grooves; the deadly East Asian death cap looks similar enough to cause confusion.
quoteEn: I have no ring, but I do have a volva.

name: 大青褶伞
fact: 它是中国报告中毒事件数量最多的毒蘑菇。孢子印呈灰绿色，这是与可食的高大环柄菇（白色孢子印）最可靠的区别。
quote: 我就长在你每天路过的草坪上。

idKeys.text: 菌褶成熟后由白色转为灰绿色，这是最可靠的一条
菌盖白色，中央有褐色鳞片，个头大
菌柄白色，有可活动的菌环，常成群长在草坪

lookalikeNotes.parasol: 高大环柄菇菌褶始终白色，菌柄有蛇皮纹；绿褶菇菌褶变绿
lookalikeNotes.chlorophyllumB: 褐鳞环柄菇菌褶始终白色，切开菌肉变橙红；绿褶菇菌褶变绿

idKeysEn: Gills turn from white to grayish green at maturity, the most reliable field mark
Cap white, large, with brown scales at the center
Stem white with a movable ring; often grows in groups on lawns
habitatEn: Urban lawns, parks and planted verges

lookalikeNotesEn.parasol: Parasol mushroom's gills stay white and its stem has a snakeskin pattern; green-spored parasol's gills turn green.
lookalikeNotesEn.chlorophyllumB: Shaggy parasol's gills stay white and its flesh turns orange-red when cut; green-spored parasol's gills turn green.

factEn: It's the mushroom behind more reported poisoning cases in China than any other. Its spore print is greenish-gray, the most reliable way to tell it from the edible parasol mushroom, whose spore print is white.
quoteEn: I grow right on the lawn you walk past every day.

name: 高大环柄菇
fact: 菌柄上有蛇皮般的褐色花纹，菌环可以上下滑动；与它混淆的大青褶伞孢子印是绿的。
quote: 我的菌环能上下滑动，试试看。

idKeys.text: 菌盖大而平展，褐色鳞片呈同心排列
菌柄细长，有蛇皮状花纹
菌环厚实，可以上下滑动

idKeysEn: Cap large and flat, with brown scales arranged in concentric rings
Stem slender, patterned like snakeskin
Ring thick and movable up and down the stem
factEn: Its stem carries a snakeskin-like brown pattern, and the ring can slide up and down; the green-spored parasol it's often confused with has, as the name suggests, a green spore print.
quoteEn: My ring slides up and down the stem. Go ahead, try it.

name: 肉褐鳞环柄菇
fact: 个头很小却含鹅膏毒肽，是中国致死种之一；它常出现在小区绿化带，容易被当成草地上的小蘑菇忽视。
quote: 我个子小，毒性不小。

idKeys.text: 个头小，菌盖褐色鳞片呈同心圆排列
菌柄下部有褐色环带状鳞片，上部有菌环痕
菌褶白色，常见于花园、草地和路边

lookalikeNotes.parasol: 高大环柄菇个头大得多，菌柄有蛇皮纹和可活动的菌环
lookalikeNotes.fairyring: 硬柄小皮伞菌盖光滑无鳞片，菌柄坚韧无菌环

idKeysEn: Small, with brown cap scales arranged in concentric circles
Lower stem banded with brown scales; upper stem shows a ring zone
Gills white; common in gardens, lawns, and roadsides
habitatEn: Urban lawns, flower beds and parks

lookalikeNotesEn.parasol: Parasol mushroom is far larger, with a snakeskin-patterned stem and a movable ring.
lookalikeNotesEn.fairyring: Fairy ring champignon has a smooth, scaleless cap and a tough stem with no ring.

factEn: Small in size but packed with amatoxins, it's one of China's deadly species; it often turns up in residential planting beds, easily dismissed as just another little lawn mushroom.
quoteEn: I'm small. My toxicity isn't.

name: 亚稀褶红菇
fact: 引起横纹肌溶解型中毒，死亡率很高。菌褶稀疏、伤后变红但**不再变黑**，可食的稀褶红菇则会先红后黑。
quote: 只变红，不变黑。请记住这半句。

idKeys.text: 菌盖灰白至浅褐色，中央下凹
菌褶稀疏而厚，受伤后先变红再缓慢变黑
菌柄粗短白色，切开后菌肉也会缓慢变红

lookalikeNotes.blackening: 黑变红菇受伤先变红再变黑但过程慢；亚稀褶红菇菌褶更稀更厚，变红更快

idKeysEn: Cap grayish white to pale brown, center depressed
Gills sparse and thick, bruising red then slowly blackening
Stem short, stout, and white; flesh also slowly reddens when cut
habitatEn: Ground in broadleaf woods of southern China

lookalikeNotesEn.blackening: Blackening brittlegill reddens then blackens when damaged, but slowly; rank russula has sparser, thicker gills and reddens faster.

factEn: It causes rhabdomyolysis poisoning with a high death rate. Its gills are sparse and bruise red but never turn black — while the edible blackening brittlegill goes red, then black.
quoteEn: Red, but never black. Remember that half-sentence.

name: 毒红菇
fact: 胃肠型毒菌，名字直译就是「让人吐的那个」；鲜红的菌盖表皮很容易整片撕下来。
quote: 我的名字就是症状。

idKeys.text: 菌盖鲜红色，湿时黏滑，表皮容易剥离
菌褶纯白，菌柄纯白，与菌盖对比鲜明
多长在松树下的苔藓地

lookalikeNotes.charcoalburner: 蓝黄红菇菌盖紫绿杂色且菌褶柔韧不易碎；毒红菇鲜红且菌褶脆

idKeysEn: Cap bright red, sticky when wet; skin peels easily
Gills and stem pure white, sharply contrasting with the cap
Grows mostly in mossy ground under pine

lookalikeNotesEn.charcoalburner: Charcoal burner has a mottled purple-green cap and pliable gills that don't crumble; the sickener is bright red with brittle gills.

factEn: A gastrointestinal-irritant mushroom whose Latin name literally means 'the one that makes you vomit'; the bright red cap skin peels off in one clean piece.
quoteEn: My name is basically the symptom.

name: 秋生盔孢伞
habitat: 针叶树腐木，常与可食种同木
fact: 它含与毒鹅膏相同的鹅膏毒肽，却长得像冬菇和蜜环菌，还常常挤在同一根朽木上——孢子印锈褐色是关键区别。
quote: 我和你的晚饭长在同一根木头上。

idKeys.text: 菌盖蜜黄至褐色，小型，湿时颜色更深
菌柄有膜质菌环，菌褶锈褐色
丛生于腐木上，秋季多见，和可食的冬菇长在同样的地方

lookalikeNotes.velvetfoot: 冬菇菌柄深褐色绒毛状且无菌环；秋盔孢伞菌柄有膜质菌环
lookalikeNotes.honey: 蜜环菌个头大、丛生于树基、有明显白色菌环；秋盔孢伞小型，菌环薄易脱
lookalikeNotes.enoki: 野生金针菇菌柄绒毛状深褐、无菌环、孢子印白；秋盔孢伞有菌环、孢子印锈褐
lookalikeNotes.woodtuft: 毛腿库恩菌菌柄下部有褐色小鳞片、菌盖两色；秋盔孢伞菌柄光滑有膜质菌环
lookalikeNotes.humongous: 奥氏蜜环菌大型、有明显菌环、丛生树基；秋盔孢伞小型，菌环薄

idKeysEn: Cap small, honey-yellow to brown, darker when wet
Stem with a membranous ring; gills rusty brown
Clusters on rotten wood, common in autumn, sharing habitat with velvet shank
habitatEn: Rotting conifer wood, often on the same log as edible species

lookalikeNotesEn.velvetfoot: Velvet shank has a dark brown velvety stem and no ring; funeral bell has a membranous ring on the stem.
lookalikeNotesEn.honey: Honey fungus is large, clumped at tree bases, with a prominent white ring; funeral bell is small, with a thin ring that soon falls away.
lookalikeNotesEn.enoki: Wild enoki has a dark brown velvety stem, no ring and a white spore print; funeral bell has a ring and a rusty-brown spore print.
lookalikeNotesEn.woodtuft: Sheathed woodtuft has small brown scales on the lower stem and a two-toned cap; funeral bell has a smooth stem with a membranous ring.
lookalikeNotesEn.humongous: Humongous fungus is large, with a prominent ring, clumped at tree bases; funeral bell is small with a thin ring.

factEn: It carries the same amatoxins as the death cap but looks like velvet shank or honey fungus, often crowding onto the very same rotting log — a rusty-brown spore print is the key giveaway.
quoteEn: Your dinner and I grow on the very same log.

name: 簇生垂幕菇
fact: 硫黄色的大丛几乎全年可见，味极苦；常被当成蜜环菌采回，是欧洲常见的中毒原因。
quote: 苦得让人吐出来，算我救你一命。

idKeys.text: 菌盖硫磺黄色，中央略带橙褐
菌褶初为黄色，成熟后转为灰绿至紫黑色
密集丛生于腐木和树桩上

lookalikeNotes.honey: 蜜环菌菌褶白色、有菌环；簇生垂幕菇菌褶黄绿转紫黑，无真正菌环
lookalikeNotes.hypholomaL: 砖红垂幕菇菌盖砖红色、菌褶灰色；簇生垂幕菇硫磺黄、菌褶黄绿

idKeysEn: Cap sulphur-yellow, faintly orange-brown at the center
Gills yellow at first, aging to grayish green then purplish black
Densely clustered on rotten wood and stumps
habitatEn: Stumps and buried wood, in dense clumps

lookalikeNotesEn.honey: Honey fungus has white gills and a ring; sulphur tuft's gills go from yellow-green to purple-black and it has no true ring.
lookalikeNotesEn.hypholomaL: Brick cap has a brick-red cap and grey gills; sulphur tuft is sulphur-yellow with yellow-green gills.

factEn: Its sulfur-yellow clusters can be found nearly year-round and taste intensely bitter; it's often mistaken for honey fungus and picked by mistake, making it a common cause of poisoning in Europe.
quoteEn: Bitter enough to make you spit me out — consider that me saving your life.

name: 细鳞丝膜菌
fact: 含奥来毒素，专门损害肾脏，而且潜伏期长达两三周——等症状出现时，早就没人记得吃过什么蘑菇了。
quote: 等你想起我，已经过去三个星期。

idKeys.text: 菌盖红褐至橙褐色，圆锥形，表面有细纤维
菌柄黄褐色，有浅黄色环带状丝膜残迹
菌褶锈褐色，长在针叶林苔藓地

lookalikeNotes.gypsy: 皱盖丝膜菌菌盖有白霜状覆盖、有膜质菌环；毒丝膜菌红褐圆锥形，只有丝膜痕

idKeysEn: Cap reddish brown to orange-brown, conical, finely fibrous
Stem yellowish brown, banded with pale yellow cortina remnants
Gills rusty brown; grows in mossy conifer forest

lookalikeNotesEn.gypsy: Gypsy mushroom has a frosted-looking cap and a membranous ring; deadly webcap is red-brown and conical, with only a cobweb-like trace.

factEn: It contains orellanine, a toxin that targets the kidneys, with a latency period stretching two to three weeks — by the time symptoms appear, no one remembers eating any mushroom at all.
quoteEn: By the time you remember me, three weeks will have gone by.

name: 鹿花菌
fact: 含鹿花菌素，在体内转化成的一甲基肼是火箭燃料成分之一。它的菌盖是脑状皱褶的实心团块，羊肚菌则是蜂窝状且中空。
quote: 切开看看：我是实心的脑子，他是空心的蜂窝。

idKeys.text: 菌盖红褐色，呈不规则脑状褶皱，不是蜂窝状
菌柄短粗白色，内部有腔室
春季长在针叶林沙质土上

lookalikeNotes.morel: 羊肚菌帽部是蜂窝状凹坑且内部中空一体；鹿花菌是脑状褶皱且内部有腔室
lookalikeNotes.blackmorel: 黑脉羊肚菌帽部纵向棱脊如梯；鹿花菌是无规则的脑状褶皱
lookalikeNotes.saddle: 皱马鞍菌白色马鞍形帽、柄有深沟槽；鹿花菌红褐色脑状

idKeysEn: Cap reddish brown, irregularly brain-like and wrinkled, not honeycombed
Stem short, stout, and white, chambered inside
Grows in spring on sandy soil in conifer forests
habitatEn: Sandy soil in conifer woods, burnt ground

lookalikeNotesEn.morel: Morel's cap is honeycomb-pitted and hollow in one piece; false morel is brain-like and wrinkled, with chambers inside.
lookalikeNotesEn.blackmorel: Black morel's cap has ladder-like vertical ridges; false morel is irregularly brain-like and wrinkled.
lookalikeNotesEn.saddle: White saddle has a white saddle-shaped cap and a deeply grooved stem; false morel is red-brown and brain-like.

factEn: It contains gyromitrin, which the body converts into monomethylhydrazine — the same compound used as rocket fuel. Its cap is a solid, brain-like mass of folds, while a true morel's is hollow and honeycombed.
quoteEn: Cut me open: I'm a solid brain. The morel's a hollow honeycomb.

name: 奥尔类脐菇
fact: 菌褶在暗处会发出微弱绿光。它与鸡油菌最大的区别是长在木头上、有真正锐利的菌褶，而鸡油菌长在地上、只有钝棱。
quote: 熄灯之后，你就认得出我了。

idKeys.text: 通体橙色，菌褶是真正的刀状薄片并向下延生
菌肉橙色，夜间菌褶会发出微弱绿光
成丛长在树桩或埋木上，鸡油菌则单生于土中

lookalikeNotes.chanterelle: 鸡油菌下方是钝棱脉不是真菌褶，单生于土中；杰克灯笼菌菌褶锐利，丛生于木上

idKeysEn: Entirely orange; gills true blade-like lamellae, running down the stem
Flesh orange; gills faintly glow green at night
Grows in clusters on stumps or buried wood, unlike the singly growing chanterelle in soil
habitatEn: Oak stumps and buried roots, in clumps

lookalikeNotesEn.chanterelle: Chanterelle has blunt ridges beneath, not true gills, and grows singly from soil; jack-o'-lantern has sharp gills and clusters on wood.

factEn: Its gills glow faintly green in the dark. Its biggest difference from the chanterelle: it grows on wood and has true, sharp-edged gills, while the chanterelle grows from the ground and has only blunt ridges.
quoteEn: Turn off the lights, and you'll know it's me.

name: 月夜菌
fact: 日本中毒事件数最多的蘑菇，因为它与平菇长在同样的枯木上；掰开菌柄基部有一块黑紫色斑，夜里菌褶发绿光。
quote: 白天我像平菇。晚上我不装了。

idKeys.text: 菌盖紫褐至深褐色，贝壳形，长在山毛榉枯木上
菌柄短，切开后柄基部菌肉有紫黑色斑
夜间菌褶发出淡绿色光

lookalikeNotes.oyster: 平菇菌柄基部切开无紫黑斑；月夜菌柄基部菌肉有紫黑色斑
lookalikeNotes.lateoyster: 晚生北风菌菌褶黄色、菌盖橄榄绿；月夜菌菌褶白色、菌盖紫褐

idKeysEn: Cap purplish brown to dark brown, shell-shaped, growing on dead beech
Stem short; flesh at the stem base shows a purplish black patch when cut
Gills glow pale green at night

lookalikeNotesEn.oyster: Oyster mushroom shows no dark blotch when the stem base is cut; moonlight mushroom has a purple-black blotch in the flesh at the stem base.
lookalikeNotesEn.lateoyster: Late oyster has yellow gills and an olive-green cap; moonlight mushroom has white gills and a purple-brown cap.

factEn: The mushroom behind more poisoning cases in Japan than any other, because it grows on the same dead wood as oyster mushrooms; snap the stem base and you'll find a dark purple-black patch, and at night the gills glow green.
quoteEn: By day I pass for an oyster mushroom. By night, I stop pretending.

name: 荧光小菇
habitat: 亚热带竹林、阔叶林腐枝
fact: 发光靠荧光素与荧光素酶反应，与萤火虫同一原理；出菇后的第二个夜晚最亮，之后迅速变暗。
quote: 我只亮一个晚上，你要赶上。

idKeys.text: 白天是灰白色半透明小菇，认不出来
夜间整个菌体发出绿色荧光
雨季长在竹林和阔叶林的枯枝落叶上

idKeysEn: By day just a small, grayish white, translucent mushroom, easy to overlook
The entire fruitbody glows green at night
Grows in the rainy season on fallen twigs and leaf litter in bamboo and hardwood forests
habitatEn: Rotting twigs in subtropical bamboo and broadleaf forests
factEn: It glows through a luciferin-luciferase reaction, the same chemistry fireflies use; it shines brightest on its second night after fruiting, then fades fast.
quoteEn: I only shine for one night. Don't miss it.

name: 苦扇菇
fact: 有趣的是只有北美的群体会发光，欧洲的同种几乎不发光——同一个物种，两种夜生活。
quote: 我发不发光，取决于我住在哪个大洲。

idKeys.text: 小型贝壳形，淡褐色，侧生短柄
层叠丛生于枯木上
北美的个体夜间发光，亚洲的多不发光

idKeysEn: Small, shell-shaped, pale brown, with a short lateral stem
Grows in overlapping clusters on dead wood
North American specimens glow at night; Asian ones usually do not
factEn: Curiously, only its North American populations glow — the same species in Europe barely lights up at all. One species, two very different nightlives.
quoteEn: Whether I glow depends entirely on which continent I live on.

name: 白鬼笔
fact: 顶端的黑绿色黏液带着腐肉气味，专门招苍蝇来把孢子带走——它把传粉这件事外包给了苍蝇。
quote: 我不用风，我雇苍蝇。

idKeys.text: 白色海绵状菌柄，顶端是墨绿色黏滑的孢体帽
有强烈的腐臭味，招来苍蝇
从一颗白色的蛋里长出，几小时就长成

idKeysEn: Stem white and spongy, topped with a slimy olive-green spore cap
Has a strong carrion smell that attracts flies
Emerges from a white "egg", maturing within hours
factEn: The blackish-green slime on its tip smells like rotting flesh, drawing flies that carry its spores away — it has outsourced pollination to flies.
quoteEn: I don't rely on the wind. I hire flies.

name: 红笼头菌
fact: 它从一颗白色的「蛋」里撑开成鲜红的镂空笼子，整个过程只要几个小时，笼子内侧涂满带臭味的孢子泥。
quote: 我是从蛋里长出来的一只笼子。

idKeys.text: 鲜红色网笼状，没有菌柄
从白色的蛋里长出，内壁有臭味的孢体
长在花园和木屑覆盖物上

idKeysEn: Bright red, cage-like lattice, stemless
Emerges from a white "egg"; inner walls bear foul-smelling spore mass
Grows in gardens and on wood-chip mulch
factEn: It bursts from a white 'egg' into a bright red, lattice-like cage in just a few hours, the inside smeared with foul-smelling spore slime.
quoteEn: I'm a cage that hatched from an egg.

name: 章鱼鬼笔
fact: 原产澳新，一战期间随军需物资传入欧洲；破壳后伸出四到七条鲜红触手，像一只倒扣的章鱼。
quote: 我是坐着军舰来欧洲的。

idKeys.text: 鲜红色触手状分叉，展开像海星
触手内侧有黑色臭味的孢体
从白色的蛋里长出，长在木屑和草地

idKeysEn: Bright red, tentacle-like arms that spread out starfish-like
Inner surface of the arms bears a black, foul-smelling spore mass
Emerges from a white "egg"; grows in wood chips and lawns
habitatEn: Grassland and mulch at woodland edges
factEn: Native to Australia and New Zealand, it hitched a ride to Europe with military supplies during World War I; once hatched, it spreads four to seven bright red arms, like an upturned octopus.
quoteEn: I sailed to Europe on a warship.

name: 出血齿菌
fact: 幼菌表面渗出的鲜红液滴其实是根压把多余水分挤出来的，里面含有一种抗凝血成分。
quote: 我流的不是血，是被挤出来的水。

idKeys.text: 幼时白色菌盖表面渗出鲜红色液滴
菌盖下方是密生的短齿刺，老菌整体变褐
长在针叶林地面，常几朵连成一片

idKeysEn: Cap white when young, oozing bright red droplets on the surface
Underside bears dense short spines; old fruitbodies turn brown overall
Grows on the floor of conifer forests, often fused into a patch
factEn: The bright red droplets oozing from a young specimen are actually excess water forced out by root pressure, and they contain an anticoagulant compound.
quoteEn: That's not blood. It's just water being squeezed out.

name: 霍氏粉褶菌
fact: 新西兰五十元纸币上印着它。那身靛蓝来自三种叠氮类色素，是自然界罕见的蓝。
quote: 我上过钞票。

idKeys.text: 整体鲜蓝色，菌盖圆锥形
菌褶蓝色带红色边缘
长在新西兰和印度的森林

idKeysEn: Entirely bright blue, cap conical
Gills blue with red edges
Grows in the forests of New Zealand and India
habitatEn: Southern beech forests of New Zealand
factEn: It's printed on New Zealand's fifty-dollar note. Its indigo blue comes from three rare azulene pigments — true blue is scarce in nature.
quoteEn: I've been on the money.

name: 靛蓝乳菇
fact: 掰开会流出深靛蓝色的乳汁，暴露在空气中慢慢变成墨绿——世界上少有的蓝色食用菌。
quote: 我流蓝色的乳汁。

idKeys.text: 整体靛蓝色，菌盖有同心环纹
受伤流出蓝色乳汁，久了变绿
长在美洲和东亚的林地

idKeysEn: Entirely indigo blue, cap marked with concentric zones
Bleeds blue latex when cut, turning green over time
Grows in woodlands of the Americas and East Asia
factEn: Break it open and deep indigo-blue milk oozes out, slowly turning inky green in the air — one of the world's few genuinely blue mushrooms.
quoteEn: I bleed blue milk.

name: 紫珊瑚菌
fact: 它是草地健康的指示物种，只出现在长期未被施肥翻耕的地方，在欧洲多国被列入红色名录。
quote: 看到我，说明这片草地很干净。

idKeys.text: 整体紫色，珊瑚状分枝
质地脆，长在草地和林地
颜色鲜艳，在绿草中很显眼

idKeysEn: Entirely purple, with coral-like branches
Brittle in texture; grows in grassland and woodland
Vividly colored, standing out against green grass
factEn: An indicator of healthy grassland, it only appears where the soil has gone untilled and unfertilized for years, and it's listed on the Red List in several European countries.
quoteEn: If you see me, this meadow has never been touched.

name: 猩红肉杯菌
fact: 早春残雪未化时就出现在苔藓覆盖的落枝上，成熟时轻碰一下会「噗」地喷出一小团孢子云。
quote: 雪还没化，我就来了。

idKeys.text: 鲜红色杯状，杯口略内卷
杯外侧淡色有细毛
早春长在落叶层的枯枝上

idKeysEn: Bright red, cup-shaped, with a slightly inrolled rim
Outer surface pale and finely hairy
Grows in early spring on fallen twigs in leaf litter
factEn: It appears in early spring while patches of snow still linger, on moss-covered fallen branches; a light tap when mature sends up a small puff of spore cloud.
quoteEn: The snow hasn't even melted, and here I am.

name: 橙黄网孢盘菌
fact: 长得像被随手丢在地上的橘子皮，常成群出现在压实的泥土路面上。
quote: 别踩，我不是垃圾。

idKeys.text: 亮橙色杯盘状，像扔在地上的橙子皮
没有菌柄，直接贴地
长在裸露的土地和路边，常成群

idKeysEn: Bright orange, cup- or disc-shaped, like a discarded orange peel
Stemless, sitting directly on the ground
Grows on bare soil and roadsides, often in groups
habitatEn: Bare soil on roadsides and forest tracks
factEn: It looks exactly like an orange peel tossed carelessly on the ground, often appearing in clusters on compacted dirt paths.
quoteEn: Don't step on me. I'm not litter.

name: 小孢绿杯盘菌
fact: 它的菌丝把木头染成蓝绿色，这种「绿橡木」在英国被用来做 Tunbridge 木镶嵌工艺已有几百年。
quote: 我把木头染绿，工匠们等着用。

idKeys.text: 蓝绿色小杯盘，只有几毫米宽
着生的枯木也被染成同样的蓝绿色
长在阔叶树尤其栎木的枯枝上

idKeysEn: Small blue-green cup or disc, only a few millimeters wide
The dead wood it grows on is stained the same blue-green
Grows on dead branches of hardwoods, especially oak
factEn: Its mycelium stains wood a striking blue-green; that 'green oak' has been used in English Tunbridge ware marquetry for centuries.
quoteEn: I dye the wood green, and craftsmen line up for it.

name: 鹿角炭角菌
fact: 顶端沾着白色分生孢子粉，像烧尽的烛芯；它的菌丝体在黑暗中会发出极微弱的光。
quote: 我像一根用完的蜡烛。

idKeys.text: 黑色扁平细柄，顶端覆白色粉末像烛芯
上部常分成鹿角状叉，质地硬韧
长在腐木和树桩上，全年可见

idKeysEn: Stem black, flattened, and slender, tip dusted white like a candle wick
Upper part often forks antler-like, tough in texture
Grows on rotten wood and stumps, visible year-round
factEn: Its tips are dusted with white conidial powder, resembling a spent candlewick; its mycelium gives off an extremely faint glow in the dark.
quoteEn: I look like a candle that's already burned out.

name: 多形炭角菌
fact: 一丛黑色肿胀的指状体从树桩边的土里伸出来，因此得名；它的木质非常坚硬，能存在整个冬天。
quote: 从土里伸出来的，是我的手。

idKeys.text: 黑色棒状，从地面伸出像手指
表面粗糙，内部白色
丛生于埋在土里的腐木上

idKeysEn: Black and club-shaped, poking from the ground like fingers
Surface rough; flesh white inside
Clusters on rotten wood buried in soil
factEn: A cluster of blackened, swollen finger-like stalks pokes up from the soil beside a stump, hence the name; its woody flesh is tough enough to survive a whole winter.
quoteEn: What's reaching out of the soil — that's my hand.

name: 黑轮层炭壳
fact: 切开有一圈圈同心黑白纹路，像树的年轮；干燥后极易点燃且能闷烧很久，是野外经典的天然火绒。
quote: 劈开我，里面有年轮。

idKeys.text: 黑褐色半球形，像烧焦的面包
切开内部有银灰与黑色相间的同心环
长在阔叶树枯木上，质地硬

idKeysEn: Dark brown and hemispherical, like a charred loaf
Cut surface shows alternating silver-gray and black concentric rings
Grows on dead hardwood, hard in texture
habitatEn: Dead branches of ash and other hardwoods
factEn: Cut it open and you'll find concentric black-and-white rings like tree growth rings; once dried, it catches fire easily and smolders for a long time, a classic natural tinder in the wild.
quoteEn: Split me open — I've got growth rings inside.

name: 木蹄层孔菌
fact: 五千三百年前的冰人奥茨随身带着它，加工后的菌肉能保存火种——这是人类使用真菌最古老的实证之一。
quote: 冰人带着我走过阿尔卑斯山。

idKeys.text: 马蹄形，灰褐色带同心带纹
质地像木头，多年生，一年长一层
长在桦树和山毛榉的活树或枯木上

idKeysEn: Hoof-shaped, grayish brown with concentric zones
Woody in texture, perennial, adding one layer each year
Grows on living or dead birch and beech
factEn: Otzi the Iceman, who lived 5,300 years ago, carried this fungus with him; its processed flesh could hold a smoldering ember — one of the oldest known pieces of evidence for humans using fungi.
quoteEn: The Iceman carried me across the Alps.

name: 树舌灵芝
fact: 白色的菌孔面被划过就会立刻变成褐色，画上去的线条能保存几十年，所以叫「画家的架菌」。
quote: 在我肚子上画画，能留几十年。

idKeys.text: 扁平的半圆形，上表面灰褐色有同心纹
下表面白色，划过会留下褐色痕迹，能作画
长在阔叶树树干，多年生

idKeysEn: Flat and semicircular, upper surface grayish brown with concentric zones
Underside white, marks brown when scratched, usable for drawing
Grows on hardwood trunks, perennial
factEn: Scratch its white pore surface and the mark instantly turns brown; the line can last for decades, which is how it earned the name 'artist's conk.'
quoteEn: Draw on my belly, and it'll last for decades.

name: 硫磺菌
fact: 口感像鸡胸肉因此得名，但相当一部分人食后会有胃肠反应，长在紫杉等树上的个体尤其需要警惕。
quote: 有人说我像鸡肉，也有人吃完很后悔。

idKeys.text: 亮橙黄色层叠扇形，颜色像鸡蛋黄
下表面硫磺黄色有细孔
长在阔叶树树干上，可以长成一大片

idKeysEn: Bright orange-yellow, fan-shaped in overlapping tiers, colored like egg yolk
Underside sulphur-yellow with fine pores
Grows on hardwood trunks, sometimes forming a large mass
habitatEn: Living trees and dead trunks of oak, willow and others
factEn: Named for its chicken-breast-like texture, but a good number of people get gastrointestinal reactions after eating it, and specimens growing on trees like yew call for particular caution.
quoteEn: Some say I taste like chicken. Others really regret finding out.

name: 肝色牛排菌
fact: 切开断面有大理石般的纹理并渗出红色汁液，看上去真的像一块生牛肉。
quote: 切开我，你会以为走错了肉铺。

idKeys.text: 深红色舌状，表面湿润，像一块生肝
切开有红色汁液和肉纹，下表面淡黄色有细孔
长在栎树和栗树的树干基部

idKeysEn: Dark red, tongue-shaped, moist surface, resembling raw liver
Oozes red juice with meat-like veining when cut; underside pale yellow with fine pores
Grows at the base of oak and chestnut trunks
factEn: Slice into it and you'll find marbled flesh oozing red juice — it genuinely looks like a cut of raw beef.
quoteEn: Slice me open and you'll think you wandered into a butcher shop.

name: 裂褶菌
fact: 它有两万三千多种交配型，几乎遇到同类就能配对；云南把它叫「白参」当菜吃，但它也是极少数能感染人体的真菌之一。
quote: 我有两万三千种性别。

idKeys.text: 灰白色小扇形，上表面密生绒毛
下方的菌褶沿中线纵向裂开，干时向内卷
长在各种枯木上，全球最常见的真菌之一

idKeysEn: Small, grayish white, fan-shaped, upper surface densely hairy
Underside gills split lengthwise along the midline, rolling inward when dry
Grows on all kinds of dead wood; one of the world's most common fungi
habitatEn: Dead wood of all kinds, worldwide
factEn: It has over 23,000 mating types, so it can pair with nearly any encounter of its own kind; Yunnan calls it 'white ginseng' and cooks it as food, but it's also one of the very few fungi known to infect humans.
quoteEn: I have more than twenty-three thousand sexes.

name: 桦褐孔菌
fact: 树干上那块焦炭似的黑瘤并不是子实体，而是菌核；真正产孢子的部分在树皮下，只在树死后才露出来。
quote: 你看到的那块黑炭，只是我的仓库。

idKeys.text: 黑色炭状不规则块，像烧焦的树瘤
掰开内部是橙褐色
长在活桦树的树干上

idKeysEn: Black, charcoal-like, irregular mass, resembling a burnt burl
Interior orange-brown when broken open
Grows on the trunks of living birch
factEn: That charcoal-like black lump on the trunk isn't the fruiting body — it's a sclerotium. The actual spore-producing part hides beneath the bark and only shows once the tree dies.
quoteEn: That lump of charcoal you see is just my storeroom.

name: 蛹虫草
fact: 和冬虫夏草不同，它能在米饭培养基上大量栽培，橙红色的子座在市场上叫「北虫草」。
quote: 我能被种在米饭上，那位不能。

idKeys.text: 橙色棒状，顶端表面有细小颗粒
从埋在土里或落叶下的蛹伸出
长在林地落叶层，秋季多见

idKeysEn: Orange and club-shaped, tip finely granular on the surface
Emerges from a pupa buried in soil or under leaf litter
Grows in forest leaf litter, common in autumn
habitatEn: Buried moth pupae in woodland soil
factEn: Unlike wild caterpillar fungus, it can be mass-cultivated on a rice-based substrate; its orange-red fruiting bodies are sold in markets as 'northern caterpillar fungus.'
quoteEn: I can be grown on a bed of rice. The wild one can't.

name: 偏侧蛇虫草
fact: 它操纵蚂蚁爬到叶子背面、咬住叶脉后死去，再从蚂蚁头部长出子座——位置与高度都恰好利于孢子撒向蚁道。
quote: 我让蚂蚁自己走到最合适的地方。

idKeys.text: 一只蚂蚁咬在叶脉或树枝上不动，从头部伸出一根细长子座
子座顶端有一个略膨大的头
热带雨林的林下植物叶背可见

idKeysEn: An ant clamped motionless onto a leaf vein or twig, a slender stalk growing from its head
Stalk tipped with a slightly swollen head
Seen on the undersides of understory leaves in tropical rainforest
habitatEn: Tropical rainforest, parasitic on carpenter ants
factEn: It manipulates its ant host into climbing to the underside of a leaf, clamping onto a vein, and dying there — then sprouts a fruiting body from the ant's head, at just the right height and spot to rain spores down on the ant trail below.
quoteEn: I let the ant walk itself to exactly the right spot.

name: 中华块菌
fact: 外形与欧洲黑松露极难区分，香气弱得多；早年常被大量低价出口后冒充欧洲货。
quote: 我长得像他，但我不是他。

idKeys.text: 黑色块状，表面有疣，与黑孢块菌极像
切开内部褐色带白色纹
长在云南和四川的松栎林地下

idKeysEn: Black and lumpy, warty surface, closely resembling the black Perigord truffle
Interior brown with white veining when cut
Grows underground in pine-oak forests of Yunnan and Sichuan
habitatEn: Underground in oak woods of Yunnan and Sichuan
factEn: Nearly indistinguishable in appearance from the European black truffle, though its aroma is much weaker; in earlier years it was often exported cheaply in bulk and passed off as the European kind.
quoteEn: I look like him. I'm not him.

name: 龙虾菌
habitat: 寄生在红菇属、乳菇属子实体上
fact: 它本身不是蘑菇的「身体」，而是一层寄生真菌，把宿主整个包住、扭成橙红色的一块，连味道都改掉了。
quote: 我不是一朵菇，我是一层壳。

idKeys.text: 橙红色扭曲团块，颜色像龙虾壳
是一层霉菌包住了别的蘑菇，表面粗糙有细颗粒
菌褶被包成钝棱状，原来蘑菇的形状几乎看不出

idKeysEn: Orange-red, contorted mass, colored like lobster shell
A mold coating a host mushroom, surface rough and finely granular
Gills fused into blunt ridges, the original mushroom's shape nearly unrecognizable
habitatEn: Parasitic on fruitbodies of Russula and Lactarius
factEn: It isn't really a mushroom's 'body' at all — it's a parasitic fungus that engulfs a host mushroom entirely, twisting it into a solid orange-red mass and even changing its flavor.
quoteEn: I'm not a mushroom. I'm a shell wrapped around one.

name: 耳匙菌
fact: 它只长在掉落的松果上，菌柄从盖的一侧偏生出来，整体像一把小耳勺。
quote: 我一辈子只认一颗松果。

idKeys.text: 小型褐色菌盖，侧生在细长的毛柄上
菌盖下方是灰白色的齿刺，不是菌褶
只长在埋在落叶下的松果上

idKeysEn: Cap small and brown, set laterally on a slender hairy stem
Underside bears grayish white spines, not gills
Grows only on pine cones buried under leaf litter
habitatEn: Pine cones buried in leaf litter
factEn: It grows only on fallen pine cones, with a stem attached off-center to the cap, giving the whole thing the look of a tiny earpick.
quoteEn: In my whole life, I only ever recognize one pine cone.

name: 黑耳
fact: 潮湿时是一团黑色胶块，干燥后缩成一层薄薄的黑壳贴在树皮上，下雨又能吸水复原。
quote: 晒干我，下雨我又回来。

idKeys.text: 黑色胶质团块，表面有细小疣点
湿时膨大发亮，干后缩成硬壳
长在栎树等阔叶树的枯枝上

idKeysEn: Black, gelatinous mass, finely warted on the surface
Swells and glistens when wet, shrinking to a hard crust when dry
Grows on dead branches of oak and other hardwoods
habitatEn: Fallen branches of oak and other hardwoods
factEn: When wet it's a blob of black jelly; dried out, it shrinks to a thin black crust pressed flat against the bark — then swells back to life the next time it rains.
quoteEn: Dry me out. Rain will bring me back.

name: 胶角耳
fact: 看着像珊瑚菌，摸起来却是韧韧的胶质，掰不断也搓不碎，这是它与真正珊瑚菌的区别。
quote: 我看着脆，其实很有韧劲。

idKeys.text: 橙黄色鹿角状分叉，胶质
手感滑腻有弹性，不脆
长在针叶树枯木上

idKeysEn: Orange-yellow, antler-like branches, gelatinous
Feels slippery and springy, not brittle
Grows on dead conifer wood
factEn: It looks like a coral fungus, but feels rubbery and gel-like — you can't snap it or crumble it, which is exactly what sets it apart from true coral fungi.
quoteEn: I look brittle. I'm actually tough as rubber.

name: 紫蜡蘑
fact: 英文名里的 deceiver（骗子）是说它颜色变化极大：湿时鲜紫，干燥后褪成灰白，像换了一个物种。
quote: 我干了以后，你就认不出我了。

idKeys.text: 整体紫水晶色，干后褪成灰白
菌褶厚而稀疏，同样是紫色
菌柄细而坚韧，长在林地

idKeysEn: Entirely amethyst purple, fading to grayish white when dry
Gills thick and widely spaced, also purple
Stem slender and tough; grows in woodland
habitatEn: Leaf litter in beech and oak woods
factEn: The 'deceiver' in its English name refers to how drastically its color shifts: vivid purple when wet, fading to grayish-white when dry, almost like a different species.
quoteEn: Once I dry out, you won't recognize me.

name: 鹦鹉湿伞
fact: 刚出土时通体亮绿，随着成熟从盖顶开始转黄、转橙，一朵菇身上能同时看到三种颜色。
quote: 我从绿色一路变到橙色。

idKeys.text: 菌盖幼时鲜绿色，老后转黄或橙色，表面黏滑
小型，菌柄同样黏滑，常带一抹绿色
长在老草地和苔藓地上

idKeysEn: Cap bright green when young, aging to yellow or orange, sticky surface
Small, stem equally sticky, often tinged green
Grows in old grassland and mossy ground
factEn: It emerges bright green all over; as it matures, the cap top shifts to yellow, then orange, so a single mushroom can show three colors at once.
quoteEn: I go from green all the way to orange.

name: 红湿伞
fact: 蜡伞类是草地生态的指示菌，只在几十年未被翻耕施肥的草地上成群出现，在欧洲被当作保护对象。
quote: 我是这片草地年纪的证明。

idKeys.text: 鲜红色小型菌盖，湿时有蜡质光泽
菌褶厚，红色带黄边
长在未施肥的老草地上

idKeysEn: Cap small and bright red, with a waxy sheen when wet
Gills thick, red with yellow edges
Grows in old, unfertilized grassland
factEn: Waxcaps are indicator species for grassland health, appearing in numbers only on meadows left untilled and unfertilized for decades; in Europe they're a conservation priority.
quoteEn: I'm proof of how old this meadow really is.

name: 网盖红褶伞
fact: 菌盖表面是一层粉橙色的网状凹凸胶质皮，像脑纹也像桃子；随着榆树病害减少，它在欧洲十多国被列入红色名录。
quote: 我只认榆木，榆木少了，我也就少了。

idKeys.text: 粉红至橙粉色菌盖，表面布满网状皱纹
菌褶粉红色，菌柄偏生，有时渗出红色小液滴
长在榆树的枯干或倒木上

idKeysEn: Cap pink to orange-pink, covered in a net-like wrinkled surface
Gills pink; stem off-center, sometimes oozing small red droplets
Grows on dead elm trunks or fallen logs
factEn: Its cap is covered in a pinkish-orange, wrinkled gelatinous skin, somewhere between a brain and a peach; as elm trees decline from disease, it's now on the Red List in over a dozen European countries.
quoteEn: I only grow on elm. Fewer elms, fewer of me.

name: 血红小菇
fact: 掐断菌柄会渗出暗红色的汁液，像流血一样，这在小菇属里是个很好认的特征。
quote: 掐断我的柄，我真的会流血。

idKeys.text: 粉红褐色钟形小菇，边缘有齿
折断菌柄流出暗红色汁液
丛生于阔叶树枯木上

idKeysEn: A small, pinkish brown, bell-shaped mushroom with a toothed margin
Oozes dark red juice when the stem is broken
Clusters on dead hardwood
habitatEn: Rotting hardwood, often in small clumps
factEn: Pinch its stem and it oozes dark red fluid, like it's bleeding — a distinctive field mark within the Mycena genus.
quoteEn: Pinch my stem, and I'll really bleed.

name: 犹太耳
fact: 欧洲的这一种主要长在接骨木上，中国栽培的黑木耳是另一个独立种；两者外形几乎一样。
quote: 我是欧洲的那只耳朵。

idKeys.text: 耳状胶质，红褐色，表面有细绒毛
湿时半透明有弹性
长在接骨木等阔叶树的枯枝上

idKeysEn: Ear-shaped and gelatinous, reddish brown, finely hairy surface
Translucent and rubbery when wet
Grows on dead branches of elder and other hardwoods
habitatEn: Dead branches of elder and other hardwoods
factEn: This European species grows mainly on elder trees; the black wood ear cultivated in China is a separate species, though the two look nearly identical.
quoteEn: I'm the European ear.

name: 黄斑蘑菇
fact: 是欧洲最常见的胃肠型中毒原因之一。切开菌柄基部会迅速泛出铬黄色，并散出一股墨水或石炭酸的气味。
quote: 切开我的脚，你会闻到墨水味。

idKeys.text: 菌柄基部切开或擦伤后迅速变亮黄色
闻起来有酚味，像消毒水或墨水
外观像可食的蘑菇属，菌褶粉红转褐色

lookalikeNotes.button: 双孢蘑菇擦伤不变黄且无酚味；黄斑蘑菇基部擦伤立即变亮黄
lookalikeNotes.fieldmushroom: 野蘑菇擦伤略变粉；黄斑蘑菇基部变亮黄且有墨水味
lookalikeNotes.horsemushroom: 大肥菇擦伤变淡黄且有茴香甜味；黄斑蘑菇变亮黄且有刺鼻酚味

idKeysEn: Stem base turns bright yellow quickly when cut or bruised
Smells phenolic, like disinfectant or ink
Resembles common Agaricus mushrooms in appearance; gills pink, aging to brown

lookalikeNotesEn.button: Button mushroom doesn't yellow when bruised and has no phenol smell; yellow stainer's base turns bright yellow at once when bruised.
lookalikeNotesEn.fieldmushroom: Field mushroom bruises faintly pink; yellow stainer's base turns bright yellow and smells of ink.
lookalikeNotesEn.horsemushroom: Horse mushroom bruises pale yellow and smells sweetly of aniseed; yellow stainer turns bright yellow with a sharp phenol smell.

factEn: One of the most common causes of gastrointestinal poisoning in Europe. Cut into the stem base and it flushes chrome yellow within seconds, giving off a smell of ink or carbolic acid.
quoteEn: Slice into my base and you'll catch a whiff of ink.

name: 野蘑菇
fact: 有明显的杏仁或茴香气味，这与黄斑蘑菇的墨水味形成对比，但气味判断从来不能单独作为依据。
quote: 我闻起来像杏仁。

idKeys.text: 白色大型菌盖，擦伤后略变黄
菌褶灰粉转深褐，菌环双层，下层像齿轮
有茴香的甜香味，长在牧场和草地

idKeysEn: Cap large and white, staining faintly yellow when bruised
Gills grayish pink, darkening to deep brown; ring double-layered, the lower layer gear-like
Smells sweetly of anise; grows in pastures and meadows
factEn: It has a distinct almond or anise scent, a sharp contrast to the yellow stainer's inky smell — though scent alone should never be the deciding test.
quoteEn: I smell like almonds.

name: 卷边桩菇
fact: 它曾长期被当作可食菌，直到有人反复食用后发生致命的免疫性溶血——毒性不是一次吃出来的，而是身体逐渐被致敏。
quote: 吃我一百次没事，第一百零一次可能出事。

idKeys.text: 菌盖边缘明显向内卷曲，黄褐色
菌褶向下延生，受伤后变褐色
常见于桦树等阔叶树下

lookalikeNotes.saffronmilk: 松乳菇受伤流出橙红色乳汁；卷边桩菇没有乳汁，菌褶按压只变褐
lookalikeNotes.blackening: 稀褶红菇菌褶厚而稀疏、受伤先红后黑；卷边桩菇菌褶密且边缘明显内卷

idKeysEn: Cap margin distinctly inrolled, yellowish brown
Gills run down the stem, browning when bruised
Common under birch and other hardwoods
habitatEn: Ground in birch and oak woods
factEn: It was long regarded as an edible mushroom, until repeated consumption was found to trigger fatal immune-mediated blood destruction in some people — the danger doesn't come from a single meal, but from the body slowly becoming sensitized.
quoteEn: Eat me ninety-nine times and you're fine. The hundredth time might not be.

name: 苦粉孢牛肝菌
fact: 无毒，但苦到只要一小块就能毁掉一整锅汤。与美味牛肝菌的区别之一是菌柄网纹粗而深褐，菌孔带粉色。
quote: 我不毒。我只是能毁掉你的晚饭。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色，菌柄有深褐色粗网纹
菌孔白色转粉红，老菌明显发粉
长在针叶林，味极苦

idKeysEn: Cap brown; stem coarsely netted with dark brown
Pores white, turning pink; distinctly pink in old specimens
Grows in conifer forests; extremely bitter
factEn: Not toxic, but bitter enough that a single small piece can ruin a whole pot of soup. One way to tell it from porcini: its stem netting is coarser and darker brown, and its pores have a pinkish tint.
quoteEn: I'm not poisonous. I'll just ruin your dinner.

name: 撒旦牛肝菌
fact: 灰白菌盖配血红菌孔，粗壮的菌柄上有红色网纹；生食会引起剧烈呕吐，是欧洲最著名的毒牛肝菌。
quote: 白帽子，红袜子，别惹我。

idKeys.text: 菌盖灰白色，菌柄粗壮呈红色并有网纹
菌孔红色，切开后菌肉变蓝
长在石灰质土壤的阔叶林

lookalikeNotes.jianshouqing: 见手青菌盖褐色不是灰白，菌柄红黄相间
lookalikeNotes.porcini: 美味牛肝菌菌孔白转黄绿、菌柄白褐有网纹、不变蓝；撒旦牛肝菌菌孔红色

idKeysEn: Cap grayish white; stem stout, red, and netted
Pores red; flesh bruises blue when cut
Grows in hardwood forests on calcareous soil

lookalikeNotesEn.jianshouqing: Lanmao's bolete has a brown cap rather than grey-white, and a red-and-yellow stem.
lookalikeNotesEn.porcini: Porcini's pores go white to yellow-green, its stem is white-brown with a net and it doesn't blue; Satan's bolete has red pores.

factEn: A pale grayish cap paired with blood-red pores, and a stout stem etched with red netting; eaten raw it causes violent vomiting, making it Europe's most notorious poisonous bolete.
quoteEn: White cap, red socks — don't mess with me.

name: 橘黄硬皮马勃
fact: 切开是关键：真马勃内部幼时纯白均质，硬皮马勃则是紫黑色的孢子团，外皮也厚硬得多。
quote: 切开我，里面是黑的。

idKeys.text: 外皮厚而硬，黄褐色，表面有龟裂状鳞片
切开内部为紫黑色，可食马勃内部为纯白
没有菌柄，直接贴地生长

lookalikeNotes.puffball: 网纹马勃外皮薄软、白色带小刺、内部白；硬皮马勃外皮厚硬黄褐、内部紫黑
lookalikeNotes.giantpuffball: 大秃马勃巨大纯白光滑；硬皮马勃小、黄褐色龟裂
lookalikeNotes.pisolithus: 彩色豆马勃有假根柄、切开是豆状小包；硬皮马勃无柄、内部均匀紫黑

idKeysEn: Outer skin thick and hard, yellowish brown, surface cracked into scales
Interior purplish black when cut, unlike the pure white interior of true puffballs
Stemless, sitting directly on the ground

lookalikeNotesEn.puffball: Common puffball has a thin, soft white skin with small spines and a white interior; earthball has a thick, hard yellow-brown skin and purple-black interior.
lookalikeNotesEn.giantpuffball: Giant puffball is huge, pure white and smooth; earthball is small, yellow-brown and cracked.
lookalikeNotesEn.pisolithus: Dyeball has a root-like stem and cuts open to show pea-like chambers; earthball has no stem and a uniformly purple-black interior.

factEn: Cutting one open is the key test: a true puffball's interior is pure white and uniform when young, while the earthball's is a purplish-black mass of spores, and its skin is much thicker and tougher.
quoteEn: Cut me open — inside, it's black.

name: 美丽枝瑚菌
fact: 粉橙色的分枝顶端带黄色，好看却会引起剧烈的胃肠反应；同属里可食与有毒的种外形非常接近。
quote: 好看的珊瑚，不一定能进锅。

idKeys.text: 珊瑚状分枝，粉红至橙红色，分枝顶端偏黄
基部白色粗壮，整丛可达手掌大
长在阔叶林地面，秋季多见

lookalikeNotes.coralRamaria: 葡萄状枝瑚菌分枝顶端粉红如葡萄、基部白色粗壮；美丽枝瑚菌整体粉橙、顶端偏黄

idKeysEn: Coral-like branches, pink to orange-red, branch tips yellowish
Base white and stout; the whole cluster can reach the size of a hand
Grows on the floor of hardwood forests, common in autumn

lookalikeNotesEn.coralRamaria: Pink-tipped coral has grape-pink branch tips and a stout white base; beautiful coral is pinkish-orange overall with yellowish tips.

factEn: Its pinkish-orange branches tip into yellow — beautiful, but it causes severe gastrointestinal reactions; within its genus, edible and toxic species look almost identical.
quoteEn: A pretty coral doesn't belong in the pot just because it's pretty.

name: 葡萄状枝瑚菌
fact: 云南叫「扫帚菌」，分枝顶端带粉红色，基部粗大像一朵花椰菜；与有毒的美丽枝瑚菌需要仔细区分。
quote: 我像一把扫帚，也像一朵菜花。

idKeys.text: 珊瑚状分枝，白色基部粗壮像菜花
分枝顶端粉红至酒红色，像一串葡萄
长在阔叶林地面，秋季可见

idKeysEn: Coral-like branches, stout white base resembling cauliflower
Branch tips pink to wine-red, like a bunch of grapes
Grows on the floor of hardwood forests, seen in autumn
factEn: Called 'broom fungus' in Yunnan, its branch tips carry a pink blush and its thick base looks like a head of cauliflower; it needs careful distinguishing from the toxic beautiful coral.
quoteEn: I look like a broom. Also like a head of cauliflower.

name: 毛钉菇
fact: 外形像放大的鸡油菌，橙红色喇叭上覆着粗糙鳞片；资料记载为胃肠型毒菌，但部分地区仍有食用习惯。
quote: 我像鸡油菌，放大了好几倍。

idKeys.text: 喇叭形，内侧橙红色覆盖翘起鳞片
外侧奶白色，有钝的棱脉而不是菌褶
中空直通基部，多见于针叶林地面

lookalikeNotes.chanterelle: 鸡油菌实心、通体蛋黄色、外侧棱脉钝；毛钉菇中空、内侧橙红有鳞片

idKeysEn: Trumpet-shaped, inner surface orange-red, covered in upturned scales
Outer surface creamy white, with blunt ridges instead of gills
Hollow all the way to the base, common on conifer forest floors

lookalikeNotesEn.chanterelle: Chanterelle is solid, egg-yellow throughout, with blunt ridges outside; woolly chanterelle is hollow, orange-red and scaly inside.

factEn: It looks like a supersized chanterelle, its orange-red funnel covered in coarse scales; records classify it as a gastrointestinal-irritant mushroom, though some regions still eat it by tradition.
quoteEn: I'm the chanterelle, blown up several sizes.

name: 白霜杯伞
habitat: 草坪、路边，常与仙环同域
fact: 含毒蕈碱，中毒会大量出汗流涎。它常和可食的硬柄小皮伞长在同一片草地上，个头颜色都接近。
quote: 我和草地上那位「仙环」，住得很近。

idKeys.text: 小型白色，菌盖表面有一层白霜状粉
菌褶向下延生，白色
草地群生，常与可食的硬柄小皮伞混在同一片草坪

lookalikeNotes.fairyring: 硬柄小皮伞菌盖淡褐钟形、菌褶稀疏不延生、菌柄坚韧；白霜杯伞菌盖白色带霜、菌褶延生

idKeysEn: Small and white, cap coated in a frost-like powder
Gills white, running down the stem
Grows in groups on lawns, often mixed with fairy ring champignon on the same turf
habitatEn: Lawns and roadsides, often alongside fairy rings

lookalikeNotesEn.fairyring: Fairy ring champignon has a pale brown bell-shaped cap, sparse non-decurrent gills and a tough stem; ivory funnel has a frosted white cap and decurrent gills.

factEn: It contains muscarine, and poisoning causes heavy sweating and drooling. It often grows in the same meadow as the edible fairy ring champignon, and the two look similar in size and color.
quoteEn: The fairy ring mushroom and I live right next to each other.

name: 毒粉褶菌
fact: 欧洲引起集体中毒最多的种之一。菌褶成熟后转为肉粉色，孢子印粉红，这是粉褶菌属的共同标记。
quote: 我的菌褶会变成肉粉色。

idKeys.text: 菌褶初为白色，成熟后变粉红色
菌盖灰白至淡黄褐色，个头大，边缘略波状
闻起来有面粉味，长在阔叶林

lookalikeNotes.woodblewit: 紫丁香蘑通体紫色、菌褶紫色；毒粉褶菌灰白、菌褶白转粉红
lookalikeNotes.charcoalburner: 蓝黄红菇菌柄脆一掰就断、菌褶白；毒粉褶菌菌柄纤维质、菌褶变粉
lookalikeNotes.deerpluteus: 鹿光柄菇长在腐木上、菌褶离生；毒粉褶菌长在土里、菌褶弯生

idKeysEn: Gills white at first, turning pink at maturity
Cap grayish white to pale yellowish brown, large, margin slightly wavy
Smells of flour; grows in hardwood forests

lookalikeNotesEn.woodblewit: Wood blewit is lilac throughout with lilac gills; livid pinkgill is grey-white with gills turning from white to pink.
lookalikeNotesEn.charcoalburner: Charcoal burner has a brittle stem that snaps cleanly and white gills; livid pinkgill has a fibrous stem and gills that turn pink.
lookalikeNotesEn.deerpluteus: Deer shield grows on rotting wood and has free gills; livid pinkgill grows on soil and has sinuate gills.

factEn: One of the species behind the most mass-poisoning incidents in Europe. Its gills turn flesh-pink with age, and its spore print is pink — the shared signature of the Entoloma genus.
quoteEn: My gills turn flesh-pink over time.

name: 油口蘑
fact: 曾被当作美味食用菌，直到法国出现连续多日大量食用后横纹肌溶解致死的病例，才被重新评估。
quote: 我曾经是道名菜。

idKeys.text: 菌盖黄绿至橄榄黄色，中央有褐色细鳞片
菌褶硫磺黄色，菌柄淡黄色，没有菌环
秋季长在松林的沙质地面上

lookalikeNotes.matsutake: 松茸菌盖褐色有纤维鳞片、菌柄有大菌环、有松香味；油黄口蘑黄绿且无菌环

idKeysEn: Cap yellow-green to olive-yellow, with fine brown scales at the center
Gills sulphur-yellow; stem pale yellow, no ring
Grows in autumn on sandy ground in pine forests

lookalikeNotesEn.matsutake: Matsutake has a brown cap with fibrous scales, a large stem ring and a resinous pine scent; yellow knight is yellow-green with no ring.

factEn: Once prized as a delicious edible, until cases of fatal rhabdomyolysis in France, following days of repeated heavy consumption, forced a full reassessment.
quoteEn: I used to be a celebrated dish.

name: 大毒滑锈伞
fact: 有明显的萝卜气味，湿润时菌褶边缘会挂上小水珠，干后留下褐色斑点。
quote: 闻起来像萝卜的，多半是我。

idKeys.text: 菌盖奶油白至淡黄褐色，湿时黏滑
菌褶淡褐色，边缘湿时有小水珠
有萝卜味，长在阔叶林与针叶林地面

lookalikeNotes.livid: 毒粉褶菌菌褶成熟转粉红、有面粉味；大毒滑锈伞菌褶淡褐、有萝卜味且菌盖黏滑
lookalikeNotes.fieldmushroom: 四孢蘑菇菌褶粉红转深褐且有菌环；大毒滑锈伞无菌环，菌褶边缘湿时挂小水珠

idKeysEn: Cap creamy white to pale yellowish brown, sticky when wet
Gills pale brown, beaded with droplets along the edge when wet
Smells of radish; grows on the floor of hardwood and conifer forests
habitatEn: Ground in broadleaf woods, often in rows
factEn: It has a distinct radish smell; when damp, tiny droplets bead along the gill edges, leaving brown spots once they dry.
quoteEn: Smells like radish? That's probably me.

name: 纯黄白鬼伞
fact: 就是花盆里突然冒出来的那种小黄伞。它靠盆土里的有机质生活，不伤害植物，但含胃肠型毒素。
quote: 我是你花盆里的不速之客。

idKeys.text: 通体亮柠檬黄色，菌盖表面有粉状鳞片
菌盖边缘有放射状沟纹，小型
常长在室内花盆和温室土里

lookalikeNotes.sulphurtuft: 簇生垂幕菇密集丛生于树桩、菌盖光滑；纯黄白鬼伞表面粉状鳞片，单生于盆土
lookalikeNotes.parrot: 鹦鹉湿伞菌盖黏滑带绿色调、菌褶厚而蜡质；纯黄白鬼伞干燥粉状，边缘有沟纹

idKeysEn: Entirely bright lemon-yellow, cap surface powdery-scaled
Cap margin radially grooved, small
Common in indoor potted plants and greenhouse soil
habitatEn: Potting soil in flowerpots and greenhouses
factEn: This is the little yellow parasol that suddenly appears in a houseplant's pot. It feeds on organic matter in the soil, doesn't harm the plant, but does contain a gastrointestinal-irritant toxin.
quoteEn: I'm the uninvited guest in your flowerpot.

name: 灰光柄菇
fact: 孢子印粉红、菌褶离生（不与菌柄相连）、既无菌环也无菌托，这一组特征是光柄菇属的标记。
quote: 我的菌褶碰不到菌柄。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色，表面有放射状纤维
菌褶白色转粉红，与菌柄分离
长在腐木和木屑上，没有菌环和菌托

idKeysEn: Cap brown, with radiating fibrils on the surface
Gills white, turning pink, free from the stem
Grows on rotten wood and wood chips, no ring or volva
factEn: A pink spore print, gills that are free (not attached to the stem), and no ring or volva at all — this combination marks the Pluteus genus.
quoteEn: My gills never quite touch my stem.

name: 白黄小脆柄菇
habitat: 草地上的埋木、树桩附近
fact: 菌柄极脆，一碰就断；菌盖边缘常挂着白色菌幕碎片，像镶了一圈流苏。
quote: 轻轻一碰，我的柄就断了。

idKeys.text: 米白至淡黄褐色的小型薄菌盖
菌盖边缘常挂着白色菌幕碎片
丛生于草地和埋木附近，菌柄细而脆

idKeysEn: Cap small, thin, off-white to pale yellowish brown
Cap margin often hung with white veil fragments
Clusters in grassland and near buried wood; stem thin and brittle
habitatEn: Buried wood in grassland, near stumps
factEn: Its stem is extremely brittle and snaps at the slightest touch; the cap edge often carries scraps of white veil, like a fringe of tassels.
quoteEn: The gentlest touch, and my stem snaps.

name: 冠锁瑚菌
fact: 白色分枝顶端像鹿角一样分叉成小冠；它常被另一种真菌寄生而变成灰紫色。
quote: 我的枝头开着小小的冠。

idKeys.text: 白色珊瑚状，分枝顶端呈鸡冠状细裂
质地脆，老菌变灰或带粉红
长在林地落叶层，秋季多见

idKeysEn: White and coral-like, branch tips finely divided like a cockscomb
Brittle in texture; old specimens turn gray or pinkish
Grows in forest leaf litter, common in autumn
