factEn: Its white branches fork at the tips like antlers into small crowns; it's often parasitized by another fungus and turns grayish-purple as a result.
quoteEn: Each of my branch tips wears a tiny crown.

name: 红缘拟层孔菌
fact: 生长边缘那圈鲜红或橙色的带子是它正在扩张的部分，越往内颜色越深，一圈圈记录着年份。
quote: 我的红边，是我今年长的部分。

idKeys.text: 蹄形，上表面黑灰色带红褐色边缘带
生长边白色，下表面淡黄色有细孔
长在针叶树枯木和倒木上，多年生

idKeysEn: Hoof-shaped, upper surface blackish gray with a reddish brown marginal band
Growing margin white; underside pale yellow with fine pores
Grows on dead conifer wood and fallen logs, perennial
factEn: The bright red or orange band along its growing edge marks the part still expanding; the color deepens toward the center, ring by ring recording each passing year.
quoteEn: My red rim is the part I grew this year.

name: 桦剥管菌
fact: 干燥后质地像细密的皮革，历史上被切成条用来打磨剃刀，因此也叫「剃刀磨石菌」。
quote: 理发师曾经拿我磨刀。

idKeys.text: 半圆形，上表面灰白至淡褐色，光滑无环带
下表面白色有细孔，边缘圆钝，质地像软木
只长在活的或枯死的桦树上

idKeysEn: Semicircular, upper surface grayish white to pale brown, smooth with no zones
Underside white with fine pores, margin rounded, texture like cork
Grows only on living or dead birch
factEn: Dried, its texture resembles fine leather; it was historically cut into strips for honing razors, earning it the nickname 'razor strop fungus.'
quoteEn: Barbers once used me to strop their razors.

name: 巨盖孔菌
fact: 整丛可以长到一米宽。被碰伤的菌孔面会在几分钟内变成黑色，这是它与灰树花的可靠区别。
quote: 碰我一下，我几分钟就变黑。

idKeys.text: 许多褐色扇形叠成一大丛，可达半米
下表面白色，按压后变黑
长在阔叶树树基和根部

idKeysEn: Many brown fan-shaped caps stacked into a large cluster, up to half a meter across
Underside white, blackening when pressed
Grows at the base and roots of hardwoods
habitatEn: Base of beech and other hardwoods
factEn: A single cluster can grow up to a meter wide. Bruise the pore surface and it turns black within minutes — a reliable way to tell it from maitake.
quoteEn: Bump me, and I'll turn black within minutes.

name: 毛韧革菌
fact: 它是云芝的头号冒牌货：正面同样有彩色环带，但背面完全光滑没有菌孔，表面还带一层细毛。
quote: 正面像云芝，背面就露馅了。

idKeys.text: 橙黄色薄片状，上表面有绒毛
下表面光滑无孔，这是与云芝的区别
层叠密生于枯木上

idKeysEn: Orange-yellow and thin, upper surface hairy
Underside smooth with no pores, unlike turkey tail
Grows in dense overlapping tiers on dead wood
factEn: It's turkey tail's biggest impostor: the top has the same colorful bands, but the underside is completely smooth with no pores, and the surface is fuzzy with fine hairs.
quoteEn: The front passes for turkey tail. The back gives me away.

name: 亚侧耳
fact: 东北叫「冻蘑」或「元蘑」，霜降后才大量出菇；菌盖橄榄绿到黄褐，菌柄极短偏生。
quote: 霜降之后，才轮到我。

idKeys.text: 菌盖橄榄绿至黄绿色，表面黏滑
菌褶黄色，菌柄很短且侧生
晚秋到初冬长在阔叶树枯木上

idKeysEn: Cap olive-green to yellow-green, sticky surface
Gills yellow; stem very short and lateral
Grows on dead hardwood from late autumn to early winter
habitatEn: Fallen hardwood, fruiting in late autumn
factEn: Called 'frozen mushroom' or 'yuan mushroom' in northeast China, it fruits in force only after the first frost; its cap ranges olive-green to yellowish-brown, with a very short, off-center stem.
quoteEn: Not until the first frost does it become my turn.

name: 日本红菇
fact: 白色大型红菇，菌褶密集，是东亚常见的胃肠型毒菌，常被误当成可食的白色红菇类。
quote: 白色的红菇，也可能有毒。

idKeys.text: 菌盖白色，中央下凹呈漏斗状
菌褶白色至淡黄色，密而细
长在常绿阔叶林地面

lookalikeNotes.blackening: 黑变红菇受伤变红再变黑；日本红菇不变色

idKeysEn: Cap white, funnel-shaped with a depressed center
Gills white to pale yellow, crowded and fine
Grows on the floor of evergreen hardwood forests
habitatEn: Ground in East Asian broadleaf woods

lookalikeNotesEn.blackening: Blackening brittlegill reddens then blackens when damaged; Japanese russula does not change colour.

factEn: A large white russula with crowded gills, it's a common gastrointestinal-irritant mushroom in East Asia, frequently mistaken for edible white russulas.
quoteEn: A white russula can still be poisonous.

name: 毛头乳菇
fact: 菌盖边缘密生长绒毛，乳汁白色且极辛辣；北欧有经过长时间盐渍处理后食用的传统，但生食会引起剧烈胃肠反应。
quote: 我的边上长着一圈胡子。

idKeys.text: 菌盖粉橙色带同心环纹，边缘密生白色长绒毛
受伤流出白色乳汁
多见于桦树林下的地面

lookalikeNotes.saffronmilk: 松乳菇乳汁橙色、受伤变绿；毛头乳菇乳汁白色、边缘有长绒毛
lookalikeNotes.hatsudake: 红汁乳菇乳汁暗红色；毛头乳菇乳汁白色且边缘有绒毛

idKeysEn: Cap pinkish orange with concentric zones, margin densely fringed with long white hairs
Bleeds white latex when cut
Common on the ground under birch

lookalikeNotesEn.saffronmilk: Saffron milk cap has orange milk and bruises green; woolly milkcap has white milk and a long-haired cap margin.
lookalikeNotesEn.hatsudake: Hatsudake has dark red milk; woolly milkcap has white milk and a hairy cap margin.

factEn: Its cap edge is thick with shaggy hairs, and its milk is white and fiercely peppery; northern Europe has a tradition of eating it after a lengthy salting process, but raw it causes severe gastrointestinal reactions.
quoteEn: I've got a ring of whiskers around my edge.

name: 橘黄裸伞
fact: 日本叫它「大笑茸」，因为有食用后出现异常兴奋的记载；金黄色的大丛在秋天的树桩上非常醒目。
quote: 吃了我会笑，但笑得并不开心。

idKeys.text: 菌盖橙黄至锈橙色，大型，丛生于树桩和树基
菌褶锈褐色，菌柄有膜质菌环
菌肉黄色，味极苦

lookalikeNotes.honey: 蜜环菌菌褶白色、孢子印白；橙黄裸伞菌褶锈褐、孢子印锈色、味极苦
lookalikeNotes.gypsy: 皱盖丝膜菌菌盖有白霜、菌褶淡褐；橙黄裸伞橙黄、菌褶锈褐、味苦

idKeysEn: Cap large, orange-yellow to rusty orange, clustered on stumps and tree bases
Gills rusty brown; stem with a membranous ring
Flesh yellow, extremely bitter

lookalikeNotesEn.honey: Honey fungus has white gills and a white spore print; spectacular rustgill has rusty-brown gills, a rust spore print and a very bitter taste.
lookalikeNotesEn.gypsy: Gypsy mushroom has a frosted cap and pale brown gills; spectacular rustgill is orange-yellow with rusty-brown gills and a bitter taste.

factEn: Japan calls it the 'laughing mushroom,' after records of unusual excitement following ingestion; its golden clusters are hard to miss on autumn tree stumps.
quoteEn: Eating me makes people laugh. It's not a happy laugh.

name: 麦角菌
habitat: 黑麦等禾本科植物的花序
fact: 它把麦粒替换成紫黑色的菌核。中世纪欧洲因误食含麦角的黑麦面包引发大规模中毒，被称为「圣安东尼之火」。
quote: 我曾经改写过欧洲的历史。

idKeys.text: 黑紫色角状硬块，比谷粒长且弯曲
表面粗糙有纵纹，掰开内部白色
秋季在黑麦、小麦和野草穗上取代谷粒

idKeysEn: Purplish black, horn-shaped and hard, longer and more curved than a grain
Surface rough and lined; interior white when broken open
Replaces grain kernels on rye, wheat, and wild grass heads in autumn
habitatEn: Flower heads of rye and other grasses
factEn: It replaces a grain kernel with a purplish-black sclerotium of its own. In medieval Europe, eating bread baked from ergot-contaminated rye triggered mass poisonings known as 'St. Anthony's Fire.'
quoteEn: I once rewrote the course of European history.

name: 豆马勃
fact: 切开像一块马赛克，里面是无数独立的小孢子室；它能用来染出金黄到深褐的羊毛，因此叫「染料球」。
quote: 切开我，像一块马赛克。

idKeys.text: 褐色不规则球块，有一根假根似的柄
切开内部是许多豆粒状小包
长在贫瘠的沙地和矿渣地

idKeysEn: Brown, irregularly shaped mass, with a root-like pseudostem
Interior packed with many pea-like packets when cut
Grows on poor sandy soil and mine spoil
habitatEn: Poor sandy soil and road embankments
factEn: Cut it open and it looks like a mosaic, packed with countless tiny spore chambers; it can dye wool everything from golden yellow to deep brown, earning it the name 'dyeball.'
quoteEn: Cut me open and I look like a mosaic.

name: 扇形韧革菌
fact: 环带比云芝更宽、颜色更暖，背面同样光滑无孔；辨认这一组「真假云芝」是入门者的经典练习。
quote: 我们三个长得很像，只有背面不会骗人。

idKeys.text: 扇形薄片，橙褐色带同心环带，像云芝
下表面光滑无孔，淡黄褐色
层叠长在阔叶树倒木上

idKeysEn: Fan-shaped and thin, orange-brown with concentric zones, resembling turkey tail
Underside smooth with no pores, pale yellowish brown
Grows in overlapping tiers on fallen hardwood logs
factEn: Its bands are wider and warmer in tone than turkey tail's, and the underside is likewise smooth with no pores; telling apart this trio of 'true and false turkey tails' is a classic beginner's exercise.
quoteEn: The three of us look alike. Only the underside never lies.

name: 皱锥盖伞
fact: 一朵不起眼的草地小菇，却含有与毒鹅膏相同的鹅膏毒肽；这提醒人们「小蘑菇没事」是错的。
quote: 我很小。这不代表我很轻。

idKeys.text: 小型，菌盖蜜黄至锈褐色，钟形
菌柄有膜质菌环，这是与其它小褐菇的区别
长在木屑、草坪和花坛

lookalikeNotes.fairyring: 硬柄小皮伞无菌环、菌褶稀疏白色；褶纹锥盖伞有膜质菌环、菌褶锈褐
lookalikeNotes.micaceus: 晶粒小鬼伞菌盖有闪亮颗粒、成熟自溶、无菌环；褶纹锥盖伞有菌环且不自溶

idKeysEn: Small, cap honey-yellow to rusty brown, bell-shaped
Stem with a membranous ring, distinguishing it from other small brown mushrooms
Grows in wood chips, lawns, and flower beds

lookalikeNotesEn.fairyring: Fairy ring champignon has no ring and sparse white gills; deadly conecap has a membranous ring and rusty-brown gills.
lookalikeNotesEn.micaceus: Glistening inkcap has a cap dusted with glittering granules, dissolves when mature and has no ring; deadly conecap has a ring and doesn't dissolve.

factEn: An unremarkable little lawn mushroom that carries the very same amatoxins as the death cap — a reminder that 'small mushrooms are harmless' is simply wrong.
quoteEn: I'm small. That doesn't mean I'm harmless.

name: 史氏鹅膏
fact: 北美太平洋西北部有多起把它误当松茸采食导致急性肾衰竭的病例；它没有松茸的浓烈香气。
quote: 闻不到松脂香的，可能是我。

idKeys.text: 通体白色，菌盖有锥形疣状鳞片
菌柄基部呈纺锤形膨大，有絮状鳞片
长在针叶林，常被误认为松茸

lookalikeNotes.matsutake: 松茸有松香味、菌柄基部不膨大；史氏鹅膏有难闻气味、基部纺锤形膨大

idKeysEn: Entirely white, cap with conical wart-like scales
Stem base spindle-shaped and swollen, with woolly scales
Grows in conifer forests, often mistaken for matsutake
habitatEn: Conifer forests of western North America

lookalikeNotesEn.matsutake: Matsutake smells of pine resin and its stem base is not swollen; Smith's amanita smells unpleasant, with a spindle-shaped swollen base.

factEn: The Pacific Northwest has recorded multiple cases of acute kidney failure after it was mistaken for matsutake and eaten; unlike matsutake, it lacks that strong, spicy aroma.
quoteEn: No spicy pine scent? That might be me.

name: 蓝圆孔牛肝菌
fact: 它是变蓝最剧烈的牛肝菌之一：切开后菌肉在几秒内变成矢车菊那样鲜艳的深蓝。
quote: 几秒钟，我就从白变成蓝。

idKeys.text: 菌盖淡黄色，表面有绒毛
切开或按压立刻变成深蓝色
菌柄中空，长在阔叶林沙质土

idKeysEn: Cap pale yellow, hairy surface
Turns deep blue instantly when cut or pressed
Stem hollow; grows in sandy soil in hardwood forests
factEn: One of the most dramatically blue-staining boletes: slice it and the flesh turns cornflower blue within seconds.
quoteEn: Give me a few seconds, and I go from white to blue.

name: 栗色圆孔牛肝菌
fact: 菌柄内部随成熟变成中空，轻轻一捏就瘪，这在牛肝菌里很少见。
quote: 我的柄是空心的，捏一下就知道。

idKeys.text: 菌盖栗褐色，表面有绒毛
菌柄同色，中空且脆
菌孔白色转淡黄，长在阔叶林

idKeysEn: Cap chestnut brown, hairy surface
Stem the same color, hollow and brittle
Pores white, turning pale yellow; grows in hardwood forests
factEn: Its stem hollows out with age and collapses at the lightest squeeze — an unusual trait among boletes.
quoteEn: My stem is hollow. Give it a squeeze and you'll feel it.

name: 宽鳞多孔菌
fact: 有明显的西瓜皮气味，菌盖上大片深褐鳞片排成同心圆；只有非常幼嫩时质地才不像皮革。
quote: 闻闻看，我有西瓜味。

idKeys.text: 大型扇形，黄褐色，覆盖深褐色鳞片
下表面白色，孔大而不规则
春季长在阔叶树树干上，有黄瓜味

idKeysEn: Large and fan-shaped, yellowish brown, covered in dark brown scales
Underside white, pores large and irregular
Grows in spring on hardwood trunks, smells of cucumber
habitatEn: Wounds on hardwoods and fallen trunks, in spring
factEn: It has a distinct watermelon-rind smell, with large dark-brown scales arranged in concentric rings across the cap; only when very young does its texture avoid feeling like leather.
quoteEn: Give it a sniff — I smell like watermelon.

name: 杰克逊鹅膏
fact: 北美版的橙盖鹅膏，菌盖边缘有明显棱纹；同属剧毒种就在同一片林子里，采食风险始终存在。
quote: 我是新大陆的那位皇帝。

idKeys.text: 菌盖鲜橙红色光滑，边缘有明显条纹
菌褶和菌柄黄色，菌柄有黄色菌环
基部有大而松软的白色囊状菌托

idKeysEn: Cap bright orange-red and smooth, margin distinctly striate
Gills and stem yellow; stem with a yellow ring
Base has a large, loose white sac-like volva
habitatEn: Oak and pine woods of eastern North America
factEn: North America's counterpart to Caesar's mushroom, with a distinctly grooved cap edge; deadly relatives in the same genus share its woodlands, so the risk in foraging is always there.
quoteEn: I'm the New World's answer to the emperor's mushroom.

name: 金黄喇叭菌
habitat: 针叶林苔藓地，常成大片
fact: 深秋苔藓丛里成百上千朵一起出现，中空的黄色菌柄是它的标记，可以一直采到初霜。
quote: 下霜之前，我还在。

idKeys.text: 菌盖灰褐色漏斗形，菌柄黄色中空
下方是钝棱脉，不是真菌褶
秋末大群长在苔藓地

idKeysEn: Cap grayish brown, funnel-shaped; stem yellow and hollow
Underside has blunt ridges, not true gills
Grows in large groups on mossy ground in late autumn
habitatEn: Mossy ground in conifer woods, often in large numbers
factEn: It fruits by the hundreds in mossy patches come late autumn; its hollow yellow stem is the giveaway, and foragers can pick it right up until the first frost.
quoteEn: Right up until the first frost, I'm still here.

name: 蒙古口蘑
habitat: 内蒙古草原，常成蘑菇圈
fact: 它在草原上排成巨大的蘑菇圈，圈内的草因为菌丝分解出的养分而格外浓绿，牧民靠这圈绿草找菇。
quote: 跟着草原上那圈深绿走，就能找到我。

idKeys.text: 白色大型菌盖，菌柄粗壮白色
菌褶白色，菌肉厚实
长在内蒙古草原，排成蘑菇圈

idKeysEn: Cap large and white; stem stout and white
Gills white; flesh thick
Grows on Inner Mongolian grassland, forming fairy rings
habitatEn: Inner Mongolian steppe, often in fairy rings
factEn: It fruits in enormous rings across the grassland; the grass inside each ring grows especially lush and dark, fed by nutrients its mycelium releases, and herders track that green ring to find it.
quoteEn: Follow the dark green ring across the grassland and you'll find me.

name: 榆耳
fact: 东北特产，胶质带绒毛，颜色是淡淡的肉粉色，干制后需要长时间泡发。
quote: 我是长在榆树上的耳朵。

idKeys.text: 白色至淡粉色的胶质耳状体
上表面有细绒毛，下表面光滑有细皱纹
长在榆树等阔叶树的枯木上

idKeysEn: Ear-shaped and gelatinous, white to pale pink
Upper surface finely hairy; underside smooth and finely wrinkled
Grows on dead elm and other hardwoods
factEn: A specialty of northeast China, its gel-like flesh is covered in fine down and colored a pale flesh-pink; the dried form needs a long soak to rehydrate.
quoteEn: I'm the ear that grows on an elm.

name: 紫晶蘑
fact: 比紫丁香蘑更小更薄，颜色也更容易褪；两者的孢子印都是淡粉色，这是香蘑属的特征。
quote: 我是紫丁香蘑的小号版本。

idKeys.text: 整体淡紫色，比紫丁香蘑小而颜色淡
菌盖湿时颜色深，干后褪色
长在草地和堆肥上

idKeysEn: Entirely pale purple, smaller and paler than wood blewit
Cap darker when wet, fading when dry
Grows in grassland and compost
habitatEn: Grassland, vegetable gardens and compost edges
factEn: Smaller and thinner than wood blewit, and its color fades faster too; both share the pale pink spore print typical of the Lepista genus.
quoteEn: I'm the pocket-sized version of wood blewit.

name: 洁小菇
fact: 有明显的萝卜气味，含微量毒蕈碱，也有致幻成分的报告；小菇属里少数明确记载有毒的种。
quote: 我闻着像萝卜，但别把我当萝卜。

idKeys.text: 菌盖粉紫至淡紫色，钟形，边缘有条纹
菌褶淡紫色，菌柄同色且中空
有明显萝卜味，长在落叶层

lookalikeNotes.amethyst: 紫晶蜡蘑菌褶厚而稀疏、菌柄坚韧；洁小菇菌褶密、菌柄中空脆、有萝卜味
lookalikeNotes.bleedingbonnet: 血红小菇折断菌柄流出暗红汁液；洁小菇不流汁，有萝卜味

idKeysEn: Cap pinkish purple to pale purple, bell-shaped, margin striate
Gills pale purple; stem the same color and hollow
Smells strongly of radish; grows in leaf litter

lookalikeNotesEn.amethyst: Amethyst deceiver has thick, widely spaced gills and a tough stem; lilac bonnet has crowded gills, a hollow brittle stem and a radish smell.
lookalikeNotesEn.bleedingbonnet: Bleeding fairy helmet oozes dark red juice when the stem is broken; lilac bonnet does not, and smells of radish.

factEn: It has a distinct radish smell, contains trace muscarine, and has even been reported to carry hallucinogenic compounds — one of the few Mycena species clearly documented as toxic.
quoteEn: I smell like radish. Don't mistake me for one.

name: 毛柄库恩菇
fact: 它与剧毒的秋生盔孢伞外形极像、常长在同一根木头上，欧洲的采菌教材把这一对当作最危险的混淆案例。
quote: 我旁边那位，可能会要人命。

idKeys.text: 菌盖两色：中央深褐、边缘浅黄，湿时更明显
菌柄下部有褐色小鳞片，上部有菌环
丛生于阔叶树树桩上

idKeysEn: Cap two-toned: dark brown at center, pale yellow at margin, more pronounced when wet
Lower stem finely scaled brown; upper stem with a ring
Clusters on hardwood stumps
factEn: It looks almost identical to the deadly funeral bell and often grows on the very same log; European foraging guides single out this pair as the most dangerous case of mistaken identity.
quoteEn: The one growing right next to me — that one can kill.

name: 砖红垂幕菇
fact: 与簇生垂幕菇同属，菌盖砖红色、味道不那么苦；不同资料对它食性的记载存在分歧，因此按食性不明处理。
quote: 关于我能不能吃，书上都吵起来了。

idKeys.text: 菌盖砖红色，中央深、边缘浅黄
菌褶灰白转紫褐，菌柄上有丝膜残迹
秋末丛生于阔叶树树桩上

idKeysEn: Cap brick-red, darker at center, pale yellow at margin
Gills grayish white, aging to purplish brown; stem shows cortina remnants
Clusters on hardwood stumps in late autumn
factEn: In the same genus as sulphur tuft, with a brick-red cap and a milder taste; sources disagree on its edibility, so it's left undetermined here.
quoteEn: Whether I'm edible — even the books can't agree.

name: 皱柄白马鞍菌
fact: 菌盖像一块揉皱的白马鞍，菌柄有深深的纵沟和空腔；它含有与鹿花菌类似的成分，资料记载不宜食用。
quote: 我的柄里全是空腔。

idKeys.text: 白色马鞍形帽，边缘向上翻卷
菌柄白色，有深深的纵向沟槽
长在林道边和阔叶林地面

idKeysEn: Cap white, saddle-shaped, margin curling upward
Stem white, with deep longitudinal grooves
Grows along woodland trails and on hardwood forest floors
habitatEn: Track edges and ground in broadleaf woods
factEn: Its cap looks like a crumpled white saddle, and its stem has deep grooves and hollow chambers; it contains compounds similar to false morel's, and records advise against eating it.
quoteEn: My stem is riddled with hollow chambers.

name: 黄柄胶地锤
fact: 一根胶质的小棒槌，帽子橄榄绿、柄鲜黄，整体滑腻得像一颗软糖。
quote: 我像一颗掉在苔藓里的软糖。

idKeys.text: 黄褐色胶质小头，像一颗小软糖
菌柄黄色，同样是胶质
丛生于潮湿的林地

idKeysEn: Small, gelatinous, yellowish brown head, like a little gumdrop
Stem yellow, equally gelatinous
Clusters in damp woodland
factEn: A little gelatinous club, its cap olive-green and its stem bright yellow, the whole thing slick and slippery like a gummy candy.
quoteEn: I look like a gumdrop that fell into the moss.

name: 毛舌菌
fact: 像一根根黑色的小舌头从苔藓里伸出来，表面覆着细密的刚毛，用放大镜才看得清。
quote: 我是从苔藓里伸出来的黑舌头。

idKeys.text: 黑色舌状，从地面直立伸出
表面有细绒毛，手摸粗糙
长在苔藓地和落叶层

idKeysEn: Black and tongue-shaped, standing upright from the ground
Surface finely hairy, rough to the touch
Grows in mossy ground and leaf litter
factEn: Like tiny black tongues poking up out of the moss, its surface bristles with fine hairs you need a magnifying glass to really see.
quoteEn: I'm the black tongue poking out of the moss.

name: 松塔牛肝菌
fact: 通体覆着粗糙的黑色翘鳞，像一颗松塔或一位胡子拉碴的老人；菌肉切开先变红再变黑。
quote: 他们叫我林中老头。

idKeys.text: 菌盖覆盖黑灰色粗大鳞片，像松果
菌柄也有鳞片，菌盖边缘挂着菌幕碎片
菌孔白色，受伤变红再变黑

lookalikeNotes.tigerpaw: 翘鳞肉齿菌盖下是齿刺；松塔牛肝菌盖下是菌孔，受伤变红再变黑
lookalikeNotes.chlorophyllumB: 粗鳞大环柄菇盖下是白色菌褶且有活动菌环；松塔牛肝菌盖下是菌孔，通体黑灰

idKeysEn: Cap covered in coarse blackish gray scales, resembling a pine cone
Stem also scaly; cap margin hung with veil fragments
Pores white, bruising red then black
factEn: Covered head to toe in rough, upturned black scales, it looks like a pine cone or a scruffy old man; slice into the flesh and it turns red, then black.
quoteEn: They call me the old man of the woods.

name: 奥氏蜜环菌
habitat: 针叶林活树根部与树桩
fact: 俄勒冈州蓝山有一个奥氏蜜环菌个体，菌丝网络覆盖约九平方公里、估计已存活数千年，被认为是地球上最大的单一生物。
quote: 我在地下铺了九平方公里，还在长。

idKeys.text: 褐色菌盖带深色小鳞片
菌柄有明显的白色菌环
大丛生于针叶树树基，地下菌丝可延伸数公里

idKeysEn: Cap brown, with small dark scales
Stem with a prominent white ring
Grows in large clusters at conifer bases; underground mycelium can extend for kilometers
habitatEn: Roots of living conifers and stumps
factEn: A single individual of this species in Oregon's Blue Mountains spreads its mycelial network across roughly nine square kilometers and is estimated to be thousands of years old — widely considered the largest single organism on Earth.
quoteEn: I've spread nine square kilometers underground, and I'm still growing.

name: 白块菌
habitat: 意大利北部栎、杨、柳根部地下
fact: 至今几乎无法人工栽培，只能靠训练过的狗在特定林地里找；单价常年居所有食材之首。
quote: 没人能种出我，只能来找我。

idKeys.text: 淡黄至赭色不规则块状，表面光滑
切开内部淡褐色带白色大理石纹
长在意大利北部的栎树和杨树根部地下

idKeysEn: Pale yellow to ochre, irregularly lumpy, smooth surface
Interior pale brown with white marbling when cut
Grows underground at the roots of oak and poplar in northern Italy
habitatEn: Underground on oak, poplar and willow roots in northern Italy
factEn: Still essentially impossible to cultivate, it can only be tracked down by trained dogs in specific woodlands, and its price has topped nearly every other ingredient for years.
quoteEn: No one can grow me. You can only come and find me.

name: 地星状肉盘菌
habitat: 美国德州雪松枯根、日本九州枯木
fact: 全世界只在德克萨斯和日本两地有记录，是分布最奇特的真菌之一；开裂时会发出可以听见的嘶声并喷出孢子云。
quote: 我只住在地球上两个地方。

idKeys.text: 未开时像一根深褐色雪茄
成熟后裂成星形，内侧橙褐色
只见于美国得州和日本，长在腐烂的树根上

idKeysEn: Unopened, resembles a dark brown cigar
Splits into a star shape at maturity, orange-brown inside
Found only in Texas and Japan, growing on decaying tree roots
habitatEn: Dead cedar roots in Texas, USA; dead wood in Kyushu, Japan
factEn: Recorded nowhere on Earth except Texas and Japan, making it one of the strangest distributions in the fungal world; when it splits open it releases an audible hiss and a puff of spores.
quoteEn: There are only two places on Earth where I live.

name: 火焰茸
fact: 含单端孢霉烯族毒素，是极少数据报道仅接触就可能引起皮肤反应的剧毒真菌，误食致死率很高。
quote: 别碰我。这句话我说得很认真。

idKeys.text: 鲜红至橙红色，指状或鹿角状分叉
从地面或腐木伸出，质地硬
分布于日本、韩国和中国南方，接触也可能引起皮肤炎

lookalikeNotes.stagshorn: 粘胶角耳橙黄色、胶质软；火焰茸鲜红、质地硬
lookalikeNotes.militaris: 蛹虫草橙色棒状从虫体伸出、顶端有颗粒；火焰茸从地面或腐木伸出、鹿角状分叉

idKeysEn: Bright red to orange-red, finger- or antler-like branches
Emerges from the ground or rotten wood, hard in texture
Found in Japan, Korea, and southern China; even contact can cause skin irritation
habitatEn: Buried hardwood roots and rotting wood

lookalikeNotesEn.stagshorn: Yellow stagshorn is orange-yellow, soft and gelatinous; poison fire coral is bright red and firm.
lookalikeNotesEn.militaris: Scarlet caterpillar club is an orange club rising from an insect body, with a granular tip; poison fire coral rises from soil or rotting wood, antler-like.

factEn: It contains trichothecene toxins and is one of the rare fungi reported to cause skin reactions from mere contact; accidental ingestion carries a high death rate.
quoteEn: Don't touch me. I mean that literally.

name: 红汁乳菇
fact: 乳汁是酒红色而非松乳菇的胡萝卜橙，伤后同样会转成青绿色。
quote: 我流的是酒红色。

idKeys.text: 菌盖粉橙色带同心环纹
受伤流出暗红色乳汁，之后变绿
长在松树下，初秋最常见

idKeysEn: Cap pinkish orange with concentric zones
Bleeds dark red latex when cut, later staining green
Grows under pine, most common in early autumn
factEn: Its milk runs wine-red rather than the saffron milk cap's carrot-orange, and it likewise turns bluish-green where bruised.
quoteEn: What I bleed is wine-red.

name: 珊瑚状猴头菌
fact: 与猴头菇同属，但不长成一个球，而是分成许多细枝，每根枝上垂着短刺。
quote: 我是散开的那种猴头。

idKeys.text: 白色分枝团块，整体像一丛珊瑚
每根分枝密生下垂的短齿刺
长在阔叶树枯木和倒木上

idKeysEn: White, branching mass, resembling a cluster of coral
Each branch densely covered in short, hanging spines
Grows on dead hardwood and fallen logs
factEn: In the same genus as lion's mane, but instead of forming one ball it branches into many slender twigs, each hung with short spines.
quoteEn: I'm the lion's mane that decided to branch out.

name: 毒新牛肝菌
fact: 外形与见手青类高度接近、同样伤后变蓝，但资料记载有明确的胃肠型中毒案例——「变蓝」不是可食的标志。
quote: 我也变蓝。变蓝说明不了什么。

idKeys.text: 菌盖黄褐色，表面有粉状质感
菌孔黄色，菌柄黄色带红褐色斑
切开菌肉变蓝，长在针叶林

lookalikeNotes.jianshouqing: 见手青菌盖褐色、菌柄红黄相间；毒新牛肝菌菌盖黄褐有粉状质感
lookalikeNotes.whiteonion: 白牛肝菌菌盖灰白至淡褐、菌柄淡黄；毒新牛肝菌菌盖黄褐带粉

idKeysEn: Cap yellowish brown, powdery textured surface
Pores yellow; stem yellow with reddish brown spots
Flesh bruises blue when cut; grows in conifer forests
habitatEn: Mixed conifer-broadleaf forests of East Asia

lookalikeNotesEn.jianshouqing: Lanmao's bolete has a brown cap and a red-and-yellow stem; poison bolete has a yellow-brown cap with a powdery texture.
lookalikeNotesEn.whiteonion: White onion bolete has a grey-white to pale brown cap and a pale yellow stem; poison bolete has a powdery yellow-brown cap.

factEn: It looks nearly identical to the Jian Shou Qing group and bruises blue just the same, but records document clear cases of gastrointestinal poisoning from it — turning blue doesn't mean it belongs on your plate.
quoteEn: I turn blue too. That proves nothing.

name: 皱盖钟菌
fact: 比羊肚菌更早出土，菌盖只在顶端与菌柄相连、像一顶挂着的钟；部分人食后会出现协调障碍。
quote: 我的帽子只在头顶挂着。

idKeys.text: 帽部有纵向皱褶，只在顶端与菌柄相连，像顶针套在柄上
菌柄白色，内部有絮状填充物
早春出现，比羊肚菌早

lookalikeNotes.morel: 羊肚菌帽部与菌柄下端相连成一体；皱柄钟菌帽只在顶端连接，像顶针
lookalikeNotes.blackmorel: 黑脉羊肚菌帽部蜂窝状纵脊；皱柄钟菌帽部是皱褶不是蜂窝

idKeysEn: Cap longitudinally wrinkled, attached to the stem only at the top, thimble-like
Stem white, stuffed with cottony filling inside
Appears in early spring, ahead of true morels
habitatEn: Riverside poplar and willow woods, early spring

lookalikeNotesEn.morel: Morel's cap is joined to the stem along its lower edge; early morel's cap hangs free, attached only at the top, like a thimble.
lookalikeNotesEn.blackmorel: Black morel's cap has honeycomb-like vertical ridges; early morel's cap is wrinkled, not honeycombed.

factEn: It fruits earlier in the season than true morels, its cap attached to the stem only at the very top, like a bell hanging from a hook; some people experience coordination problems after eating it.
quoteEn: My cap just hangs there, attached at a single point.

name: 皱盖丝膜菌
fact: 丝膜菌属大多不宜食用甚至剧毒，它是少数有食用记载的种；北欧采菌人靠菌盖上那层皱纹和白色菌环认它。
quote: 我们这一属，能吃的没几个。

idKeys.text: 菌盖赭黄色，表面覆一层白霜状粉
菌柄有膜质菌环，菌褶淡褐转锈褐
长在针叶林苔藓地和越橘丛间

idKeysEn: Cap ochre-yellow, coated in a frost-like powder
Stem with a membranous ring; gills pale brown, aging to rusty brown
Grows in mossy conifer forests and among bilberry shrubs
factEn: Most Cortinarius species are inedible or outright deadly, but this is one of the few with a history of being eaten; Nordic foragers recognize it by the wrinkled cap and the white ring.
quoteEn: Not many in my genus are safe. I'm one of the exceptions.

name: 紫绒丝膜菌
fact: 从菌盖到菌褶到菌柄整个都是深紫色，表面覆着细密绒毛；孢子印锈褐色是丝膜菌属的标记。
quote: 我从头紫到脚。

idKeys.text: 整体深紫色，菌盖有绒毛质感
菌褶深紫，老后转锈褐
长在阔叶林和针叶林

idKeysEn: Entirely deep purple, cap with a velvety texture
Gills deep purple, aging to rusty brown
Grows in hardwood and conifer forests
habitatEn: Ground in birch and oak woods
factEn: Deep violet from cap to gills to stem, its surface covered in fine down; a rusty-brown spore print marks it as a member of the Cortinarius genus.
quoteEn: I'm purple from head to toe.

name: 变黑湿伞
fact: 鲜艳的红黄色小尖帽，被碰过或衰老后会整朵变成炭黑色，是蜡伞里最好认的一种。
quote: 碰过我的地方，会变黑。

idKeys.text: 菌盖红橙色圆锥形，有蜡质光泽
受伤或老化后整体变黑
长在草地和林缘的草丛里

idKeysEn: Cap red-orange, conical, with a waxy sheen
Blackens entirely when bruised or aging
Grows in grassland and grassy woodland edges
factEn: A bright red-and-yellow, pointed little cap that turns coal-black wherever it's bruised or as it ages — one of the easiest waxcaps to recognize.
quoteEn: Wherever you touch me, it turns black.

name: 鹊鬼伞
fact: 深褐色菌盖上贴着大片白色菌幕碎片，像喜鹊的黑白羽毛；同样会自溶成墨汁。
quote: 我一身黑白，像只喜鹊。

idKeys.text: 菌盖深褐色，覆盖白色片状鳞片，像喜鹊羽毛
菌柄细长白色，比菌盖高很多
长在阔叶林落叶层，成熟后自溶

lookalikeNotes.shaggyink: 毛头鬼伞菌盖白色圆柱形；喜鹊鬼伞深褐色带白斑

idKeysEn: Cap dark brown, covered in white patch-like scales, like magpie feathers
Stem slender, white, much taller than the cap
Grows in hardwood leaf litter, deliquescing at maturity

lookalikeNotesEn.shaggyink: Shaggy ink cap has a white, cylindrical cap; magpie inkcap is dark brown with white patches.

factEn: Large white veil patches cling to its dark brown cap like a magpie's black-and-white feathers; it, too, dissolves itself into ink.
quoteEn: Black and white all over, just like a magpie.

name: 白蛋巢菌
fact: 杯内壁光滑不像隆纹黑蛋巢菌有纵纹，「蛋」是白色的，靠一根极细的菌索连着杯底。
quote: 我的蛋用一根线拴着。

idKeys.text: 淡黄褐色小杯，杯内装着白色扁圆的小包
杯口幼时有一层白色盖膜
长在枯枝、木屑和落叶上

idKeysEn: Small, pale yellowish brown cup, holding white flattened round packets
Cup mouth covered by a white membrane when young
Grows on dead twigs, wood chips, and fallen leaves
factEn: Unlike the fluted bird's nest, its cup interior is smooth rather than grooved; the 'eggs' are white and tethered to the cup floor by an impossibly thin cord.
quoteEn: My eggs are tied down with a single thread.

name: 狗蛇头菌
fact: 比白鬼笔细小得多，橙红色的顶端只有一小段带孢子黏液，气味也淡得多。
quote: 我是白鬼笔的小号版本。

idKeys.text: 细长的白色海绵状柄，顶端橙红色
顶端有深色臭味的孢体，被苍蝇吃掉后露出橙色
从白色的蛋里长出，长在落叶层和木屑

idKeysEn: Stem slender, white, and spongy, tipped orange-red
Tip bears a dark, foul-smelling spore mass, revealing orange once eaten by flies
Emerges from a white "egg"; grows in leaf litter and wood chips
habitatEn: Woodland leaf litter and wood chips
factEn: Much smaller and slighter than the common stinkhorn, with just a short cap of orange-red spore slime, and a far milder smell.
quoteEn: I'm the compact version of the common stinkhorn.

name: 夏块菌
fact: 外皮的疣突比黑松露更大更棱角分明，内部纹理偏浅褐，香气清淡，价格也只有黑松露的零头。
quote: 我是夏天那位，便宜得多。

idKeys.text: 黑色块状，表面有粗大的多角形疣
切开内部淡褐色带白色细纹
长在阔叶树根部的浅土里

idKeysEn: Black and lumpy, surface with coarse, angular warts
Interior pale brown with fine white veining when cut
Grows in shallow soil at the roots of hardwoods
factEn: Its warty skin is larger and more angular than a black truffle's, the inside marbled a lighter brown with a milder aroma — and a price tag that's a fraction of the black truffle's.
quoteEn: I'm the summer one, and a whole lot cheaper.

name: 粗鳞大环柄菇
fact: 菌肉切开会先变橙红再转褐，孢子印白色；与孢子印绿色的大青褶伞是关键的一对，部分人食后仍有胃肠反应。
quote: 切开我会变红，那位不会。

idKeys.text: 菌盖褐色，覆盖粗大翘起的鳞片
菌褶白色，切开菌肉变橙红
菌柄光滑无花纹，有可活动的菌环

idKeysEn: Cap brown, covered in coarse, upturned scales
Gills white; flesh turns orange-red when cut
Stem smooth and unpatterned, with a movable ring
factEn: Cut flesh turns orange-red, then brown, and the spore print is white — the key pairing with the green-spored parasol, whose print is green; some people still get gastrointestinal reactions after eating it.
quoteEn: Cut me open and I turn red. That other one won't.

name: 小孢绿杯珊瑚
fact: 比胶角耳小得多，通常是不分叉的一根根黄色小角，密密排在落枝上。
quote: 我是不分叉的那种小角。

idKeys.text: 黄色小角状，不分叉或少分叉
胶质，只有一两厘米高
成群长在阔叶树枯木上

idKeysEn: Small, yellow, horn-shaped, unbranched or sparsely branched
Gelatinous, only one to two centimeters tall
Grows in groups on dead hardwood
factEn: Much smaller than yellow stagshorn, usually growing as unbranched little yellow spikes, packed densely along fallen branches.
quoteEn: I'm the little horn that never forks.
